jobs.description:
Description:

**Hiring Range:** $20 - $23 hourly, based on qualifications and experience.

**BENEFITS AND PERKS:**

* Comprehensive health plans include medical, dental and vision benefits.
* Generous vacation, sick time, and holiday pay, plus paid birthday off and ‘refreshment’ day.
* Tuition reimbursement and child adoption benefits.
* Employer paid term life insurance, long-term disability, AD&D.
* Health savings account with generous employer contribution.
* Flexible spending accounts.
* Paid parental and bereavement leave.
* 401(k) with up to 5% company match.
* Please access our highlights of the benefits package we offer here: Denver Rescue Mission Benefits Guide

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Coordinator prepares, publishes, maintains, and reports on digital communications for Denver Rescue Mission. The position supports email marketing, social media, website content, online forms, internal communications, and related digital projects, and adapts approved materials for specific channels with short-form video, event recaps, and other digital content production. The Coordinator works closely with the Director of Digital Philanthropy, the Content Manager, the Marketing and Communications Team, external agencies, and internal partners to deliver accurate, timely, accessible, and brand-consistent content.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Email Marketing*

* Collaborates with external agencies and Mission staff to build, format, test, and send mass email campaigns using approved content and established workflows.
* Maintains email production schedules and project details in Monday.com.
* Assists other teams/departments with their communication goals as it relates to mass email communications.
* Prepares quarterly email performance reports on KPIs.
* Updates and maintains approved email content in platforms such as Pardot, Salesforce, WeGive, Formstack, Monday.com, and other systems used by the Mission.
* Supports compliance with the CAN-SPAM Act, applicable local and national data-privacy requirements, accessibility standards, consent practices, and Mission policies governing constituent communications.

*Social Media and Digital Content*

* Prepares, schedules, and publishes approved social media content across Mission channels using established content calendars and scheduling tools.
* Works with the Content Manager to adapt stories, photographs, video, campaign materials, and event content for social media and other digital channels.
* Assists with short-form video planning, capture, editing, captioning, and publication
* Produces channel-appropriate copy and visual assets from approved materials while following Mission voice, brand, copyright, accessibility, and quality standards.
* Prepares graphics, photographs, and video for digital use using approved creative tools and coordinates with staff or external partners when additional support is needed.

*Website and Internal Communications*

* Creates, updates, and maintains approved WordPress pages, blog posts, landing pages, event information, and other website content using established procedures.
* Assembles and publishes the staff newsletter webpage and email using supplied and approved content.
* Reviews digital content for accuracy, working links, dates, mobile presentation, accessibility, and consistency with current information before publication.
* Coordinates routine updates with content owners and removes or escalates outdated, incomplete, or conflicting information.

*Online Fundraising Forms and Digital Systems*

* Creates and updates approved content on WeGive fundraising pages; tests links, campaign information, suggested amounts, and form presentation before release.
* Supports the creation and maintenance of event registration, contact, volunteer, and other digital forms using the Mission's approved platforms.
* Maintains campaign names, UTM parameters, links, and related documentation to support accurate attribution, reporting, and consistent donor experience.
* Supports routine content and configuration updates in systems such as WeGive, Salesforce, Pardot, Formstack, WordPress, Hootsuite, SharePoint, and Monday.com according to assigned access and documented procedures.
* Documents repeatable processes and recommends practical improvements to content presentation, publishing workflows, reporting, or campaign execution.
* May assist with approved data integrations, platform connections, or workflow automations as training, interest, organizational need, and supervision permit; advanced automation is not a core entry requirement for the position.

*Project Coordination and Team Participation*

* Tracks assigned work, deadlines, approvals, status, and supporting information in Monday.com and other designated project-management systems.
* Coordinates assigned digital projects from brief through publication and reporting, with the level of oversight appropriate to experience and project complexity.
* Uses analytics, research, feedback, and established best practices to recommend improvements to digital content and production processes.
* Shares platform and production knowledge with teammates and may help orient interns or other staff when applicable.
* Attends Development, team, and organizational meetings as needed and completes required Denver Rescue Mission training.
* Performs other duties as assigned by the Director of Digital Philanthropy or Marketing and Communications leadership.

Requirements:

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or related field.
* Or a minimum one (1) year of experience in an equivalent field.
* A combination of education and experience can be substituted.
* Work samples demonstrating clear writing, careful editing, digital content production, social media, email, website, design, and or short-form video ability.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and interpersonal communication skills, with close attention to accuracy and audience segme

jobs.title: Director of Marketing & Growth
jobs.description:
**Director of Marketing & Growth**

Remote | Up to 35% travel | Full-time | Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

**About the Role**

The Director of Marketing & Growth leads marketing strategy for Independence Dental Services and its partner practices, with one clear goal: profitable new-patient growth. This is a hands-on leader who ties every dollar of spend to patients, collections, and gross margin, and who uses AI and modern marketing technology to work faster and smarter. You will partner closely with executives, partner dentists, and operations leaders.

**What You'll Do**

***Strategy & Budget***

* Build and execute corporate and practice-level marketing strategies, campaigns, and growth plans.
* Own the annual and monthly marketing budget; shift spend based on practice needs and return.
* Use market research and competitive data to identify target audiences and new-patient opportunities.

***Performance & ROI***

* Own marketing reporting: acquisition cost, lead conversion, appointments, collections, ROI, and gross-margin impact.
* Partner with Finance and Operations to validate results and turn findings into specific actions.

***Digital Channels***

* Manage practice websites, SEO, paid search, Google Business Profiles, and social media to generate and convert new patients.
* Hold agencies and vendors accountable for deliverables, spend, and results.

***Practice Partnership***

* Coach practices on marketing effectiveness and work with operations leaders to remove barriers such as call handling, scheduling, capacity, and patient follow-up.
* Present recommendations to leadership and train corporate and practice teams.
* Support trade shows, industry events, and corporate events.

***AI & Innovation***

* Test and adopt AI, automation, and emerging marketing tools that improve analysis, content, and campaign performance, and measure their business value.

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years of marketing experience, with a track record of profitable growth you can back up with data.
* Strong command of marketing economics: ROI, acquisition cost, and gross margin.
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, SEO, analytics platforms, and Google Workspace.
* Practical experience using AI tools to improve marketing efficiency and decision-making.
* Clear communicator who can influence dentists, executives, and vendors without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Dental, healthcare, or multi-location services experience preferred.

**Work Environment**

Remote, with regular travel to practices and events (up to 35%). Requires extended periods of computer work.

jobs.title: Social Media Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and creative Social Media Assistant to join our vibrant marketing team! In this role, you will be the driving force behind our social media presence, creating engaging content, managing multiple platforms, and analyzing performance metrics to boost brand visibility. Your enthusiasm for digital marketing and keen eye for design will help us connect authentically with our audience across various channels. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your skills in social media management, content creation, and digital marketing analytics while contributing to impactful campaigns that resonate globally.

**Duties**

* Develop and curate compelling social media content tailored for platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
* Manage daily social media activities using tools like Hootsuite and Buffer to schedule posts and monitor engagement.
* Conduct social listening to gauge public sentiment, identify trends, and respond promptly to audience interactions.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to plan and execute social media campaigns aligned with branding strategies.
* Utilize graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Creative Suite to produce eye-catching visuals and media edits.
* Monitor digital marketing performance using Google Analytics, web analytics tools, and social media analytics to optimize content strategies.
* Engage in keyword research and SEO best practices to enhance content visibility across search engines and social platforms.
* Support public relations efforts by managing online reputation and fostering positive relationships with followers and influencers.
* Track media performance analytics to assess campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements for future initiatives.

**Skills**

* Proficiency in social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, and others.
* Strong content creation skills with a focus on engaging writing, visual storytelling, and multimedia editing.
* Experience with social listening tools and social media management applications such as Hootsuite or Buffer.
* Knowledge of SEO techniques, keyword research, web analytics (Google Analytics), and marketing online analytics.
* Skilled in graphic design and media editing using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools.
* Ability to analyze social media data to measure engagement rates, audience growth, and campaign success.
* Excellent proofreading skills with an eye for branding consistency across all content.
* Effective relationship management skills for engaging with followers, influencers, and partners online.
* Familiarity with digital marketing performance monitoring tools related to social media marketing campaigns.

Join us as a Social Media Assistant if you're passionate about digital storytelling, eager to learn cutting-edge marketing techniques, and ready to make a meaningful impact through innovative online engagement!

Pay: $23.40 - $28.18 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)

jobs.title: Creative Producer, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
### **About AppLovin**

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Creative Producer to lead the execution and delivery of marketing creatives.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Brand and Video Production teams to lead creative strategy and production. You'll own the pipeline from creative brainstorming through final delivery for ads to run across brand and performance marketing campaigns. This isn't about making one perfect ad. It's about building a creative machine that feeds our growth with constant testing and iteration.

We want clever ideas, rapid experimentation and consistent excellent ad quality. If you live and breathe performance creative, understand what makes B2B advertising work, and move fast, this role was built for you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own static and video creative production.** Produce creative to run across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Twitter, CTV, OOH, and other networks.
* **Ideate and pitch.** Research and pitch creative concepts that align with our marketing plans.
* **Stay true to the brand.** The guidelines are the frame, and your job is to make the strongest ads possible inside it.
* **Build media packs and manage vendors.** Develop a media pack for each campaign to share with vendors for ad production.
* **Own ad quality.** Hold every ad to a high standard and make sure AppLovin is presented appropriately.
* **Develop or source the materials you need.** Work closely with our video production team and external vendors to get the footage you need. You source 100% of the material you need. Sometimes that means creating the work yourself with design tools and AI, sometimes it means handing it to a vendor. You decide the fastest path to the assets each ad needs.
* **Keep the pipeline full and moving.** Guide approved projects through production and final delivery while managing multiple timelines at once. While one campaign is in production, you're already strategizing the next creative delivery, planned against our marketing calendar and key seasonal moments.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* You're equal parts strategist and operator, and you thrive at the intersection of creative vision and flawless execution.
* You have a strong creative background and operational expertise. You understand the full campaign lifecycle, from early concepting to final delivery, and you're adept at steering large-scale marketing initiatives with multiple stakeholders, evolving priorities, and ambitious timelines.
* You're passionate about storytelling and marketing.

AppLovin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about EEO rights as an applicant here.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send us a request at **jobs@applovin.com**

AppLovin will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. If you're applying for a position in California, learn more here.

To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

Please read our Global Applicant Privacy Notice to learn more about how AppLovin processes your personal information.

jobs.title: Marketing & Patient Growth Manager
jobs.description:
**Make an Impact. Grow Our Brand. Connect More Patients to Care.**
------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**

Are you a marketing professional who thrives on turning strategy into measurable results? Do you enjoy combining digital marketing, brand development, analytics, and relationship-building to drive meaningful growth? Gastro Care Partners (GCP) is seeking a proactive, data-driven Marketing & Patient Growth Manager to strengthen our brand presence, elevate provider visibility, and expand patient access to care across our markets.

In this role, you will bring marketing initiatives to life that increase awareness, enhance our providers’ digital presence, strengthen online reputation, and support new-patient acquisition. Working closely with the Marketing team, Practice Operations, providers, and local leadership, you will help ensure our marketing efforts are aligned with organizational priorities and translate into meaningful business results.

A key component of this role is owning and optimizing our digital provider presence across platforms such as Rater8 and Rave. From maintaining accurate, compelling provider profiles to monitoring patient reviews and identifying opportunities to improve digital engagement, you will help create a seamless connection between how patients discover our providers and how they take the next step toward scheduling care.

This is an opportunity for a marketing professional who is equally comfortable executing campaigns, analyzing performance, identifying growth opportunities, and turning insights into action. Your work will help strengthen our reputation, increase provider visibility, and support GCP’s continued growth.

### **What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means more than launching campaigns or maintaining digital profiles. It means delivering measurable improvements in provider visibility, online reputation, digital engagement, and patient acquisition. You will use data, collaboration, and continuous improvement to help turn marketing activity into meaningful growth in new-patient inquiries and scheduled appointments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and execute targeted marketing initiatives that increase brand awareness, strengthen provider visibility, and support patient acquisition across GCP markets.
* Coordinate marketing campaigns, promotional materials, digital content, and provider-specific marketing initiatives that align with organizational goals.
* Ensure marketing materials, messaging, and communications reflect GCP’s brand standards, voice, and strategic priorities.
* Identify opportunities to expand market awareness, improve campaign performance, and support the growth of providers, practices, and service lines.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Practice Operations, providers, and local leadership to translate business needs into actionable marketing plans.

**Online Reputation & Provider Profile Management**

* Lead the ongoing management, accuracy, and optimization of provider profiles across Rater8, Rave, and other approved digital platforms.
* Ensure provider biographies, specialties, credentials, practice locations, headshots, and scheduling links are accurate, complete, compelling, and up to date.
* Establish and maintain standardized processes for profile updates, content approvals, quality assurance, and ongoing platform maintenance.
* Monitor patient reviews, ratings, and online reputation trends; coordinate timely, appropriate, and compliant responses with the relevant teams.
* Identify recurring feedback themes and partner with Practice Operations and provider leadership to address reputation concerns and improve the patient experience.
* Implement best practices that strengthen provider discoverability, profile engagement, and the overall digital experience for prospective patients.

**Digital Marketing & Patient Growth**

* Coordinate website content, provider biographies, and digital marketing assets to improve search visibility, patient engagement, and access to scheduling.
* Analyze provider profile performance, website traffic, digital inquiries, and other available engagement metrics to uncover opportunities for growth.
* Partner with Practice Operations to strengthen the connection between digital engagement, patient inquiries, and scheduled appointments.
* Identify underperforming providers, locations, or service lines and develop targeted recommendations to improve visibility and patient acquisition.
* Support data-informed marketing initiatives that help prospective patients discover the right provider and take the next step in their care journey.

**Data, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain monthly marketing dashboards, KPI reports, and performance scorecards that provide clear visibility into results.
* Track key performance indicators, including provider profile views, review volume and growth, average ratings, response timeliness, profile completeness, and patient conversion metrics where measurable.
* Prepare and present quarterly performance updates to leadership, highlighting progress, emerging trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.
* Translate performance data into actionable recommendations, targeted improvement plans, and strategies that drive measurable results.
* Continuously evaluate marketing effectiveness, refine initiatives based on performance insights, and establish repeatable processes that support consistency and scalability.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Experience with digital marketing, online reputation management, and digital profile optimization.
* Ability to track key performance indicators (KPIs), maintain dashboards, and analyze performance reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across departments,

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Clubs
jobs.description:
**About Relentless Beats**  
Born from founder Thomas Turner's passion for bringing underground music to Arizona, Relentless Beats is now one of the Southwest's most prolific independent music promoters. Producing over 400 events annually and featuring nearly 500 unique artists, Relentless Beats delivers everything from intimate club shows to marquee festivals like Goldrush Music Festival, PHXLIGHTS, Body Language, DUSK, Decadence AZ, and more.  
  
**Position Overview**  
The Marketing Manager, Clubs plans and executes marketing campaigns for Relentless Beats club events, building audience engagement and driving ticket, table-service, and VIP sales. This role works with artists, venue partners, promoters, and the marketing team across social media, email, digital advertising, and traditional media.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Digital Marketing and Social Media**

* Develop marketing campaigns for club events across social media, email newsletters, and other online channels.
* Create graphics, videos, and written content, working with external photographers, videographers, and designers as needed.
* Contribute to company social media accounts with consistent branding and messaging while engaging online communities and influencers.
* Track reach, engagement, and conversions, using campaign results and current social media trends to improve performance.

  
**Club Promotion and Sales**

* Manage promoters and influencers to increase club-event ticket sales.
* Develop group-sales campaigns and targeted local and regional promotions.
* Collaborate with the events team, venue partners, and promoters on club-event marketing plans.
* Build relationships with high-value clients and corporate groups to increase table-service and VIP sales.
* Develop pop-up events, event series, and other programming at partner venues to attract audiences and fill open calendar dates.

  
**Publicity and Content**

* Work with the publicity team on press releases, media kits, and promotional materials.
* Build media relationships and coordinate artist press opportunities, interviews, scheduling, and follow-up.
* Contribute campaign concepts and multimedia content that align with the artists and club events being promoted.

  
**Reporting and Collaboration**

* Collect and analyze sales and campaign data, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and establish realistic sales targets.
* Use historical results to forecast campaign performance.
* Collaborate with other departments to improve ticket, premium, food and beverage, merchandise, and other event revenue.
* Perform other marketing responsibilities as assigned.

  
**Qualifications and Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Music Business, or a related field.
* 4+ years of marketing experience, preferably in music or entertainment, and 2+ years of management experience.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing, audience targeting, social media analytics, email platforms, and content-management systems.
* Proficiency in graphic-design software such as Adobe Creative Suite.
* Strong working knowledge of Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Docs; familiarity with Slack and electronic signature platforms.
* Knowledge of music promotion, industry trends, and emerging technology is a plus.
* Strong communication, listening, interpersonal, and critical-thinking skills, along with sound ethical judgment.
* A creative, motivated team player who leads by example, supports process improvement, and works effectively with others.
* Ability to meet deadlines, manage heavy workloads, keep work visible, and be available for meetings and escalations as needed.

  
**Work Environment and Schedule**

* Full-time position based in the Phoenix office most of the week, with partner and venue meetings outside regular office hours.
* Frequent event attendance and travel, including evenings, weekends, and some holidays.
* Ability to work in loud, busy environments and varying temperatures at event sites.

  
**Compensation**  
Full-time position, salary negotiable. No hiring bonus.  
  
**Why Relentless Beats?**  
Join a team that powers some of the Southwest's most iconic music events, where accounting accuracy matters, the pace is exciting, and your work directly supports unforgettable live experiences.  
  
**Apply with your resume to be considered.** Only candidates who meet the minimum qualifications will be contacted.

**Job Title: Social Media Marketing & Community Outreach Coordinator**
======================================================================

**SMS Clinical Research | Mesquite, TX**

About SMS Clinical Research

SMS Clinical Research is an established clinical research site conducting Phase I–IV clinical trials across multiple therapeutic areas, including vaccines, internal medicine, pulmonology, dermatology, gastroenterology, cardiometabolic diseases, and more. We are committed to advancing medical research and connecting eligible participants with opportunities to contribute to the development of new treatments.

We are seeking a creative, organized, and proactive **Social Media Marketing & Community Outreach Coordinator** to support our clinical trial recruitment efforts, strengthen our online presence, and build relationships within the local community.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Social Media Marketing & Clinical Trial Recruitment**

Develop, design, and publish engaging social media content and advertisements for ongoing clinical trials at SMS Clinical Research.  

Create and manage IRB-approved advertisements and recruitment materials in accordance with study-specific requirements.  
Manage social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.  
Develop targeted campaigns to increase awareness of clinical trials and attract potentially eligible participants.  
Monitor campaign performance, engagement, and recruitment leads, and recommend improvements.  

**2. Landing Pages & Lead Management**

Create and maintain landing pages for individual clinical trials and recruitment campaigns.  

Develop online forms to collect prospective participant information and interest.  
Organize, track, and manage incoming leads and ensure timely follow-up or transfer to the appropriate research team.  
Maintain accurate recruitment reports, campaign metrics, and lead-tracking databases.  
Coordinate with the research team to improve the participant inquiry and recruitment process.  

**3. Community Outreach & Public Relations**

Plan and participate in community outreach initiatives to increase awareness of clinical research.  

Represent SMS Clinical Research at health fairs, community events, local organizations, and other outreach activities.  
Establish relationships with community groups, local businesses, healthcare providers, and other potential referral partners.  
Help develop brochures, flyers, presentations, and other educational materials.  
Identify new opportunities to engage diverse populations and expand clinical trial awareness.  

**4. Coordination & Compliance**

Work closely with the clinical research and recruitment teams to understand study requirements and recruitment goals.  

Ensure all trial-specific advertising and recruitment materials receive the required IRB approval before use.  
Follow applicable privacy, confidentiality, and data-protection requirements when collecting and handling prospective participant information.  
Maintain organized records of advertisements, approvals, campaigns, outreach activities, and recruitment results.  

Qualifications

Experience in social media marketing, digital advertising, marketing coordination, or a related field.  

Strong written communication, graphic design, and content creation skills.  
Experience with platforms such as Canva, Meta Business Suite, Facebook Ads Manager, and Instagram.  
Familiarity with landing-page builders, online forms, CRM systems, and lead-tracking tools.  
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.  
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to represent the organization professionally at community events.  
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet recruitment deadlines.  
Reliable transportation and willingness to attend local community outreach events.  

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in healthcare marketing, clinical trial recruitment, medical practice marketing, or pharmaceutical research.  

Familiarity with Institutional Review Board (IRB) advertising approval requirements and clinical research recruitment processes.  
Experience with lead-generation campaigns, landing-page optimization, and digital marketing analytics.  
Experience working with diverse communities and developing community partnerships.  

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is both creative and results-driven, with the ability to turn marketing campaigns into measurable recruitment opportunities. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a healthcare environment, communicating with the public, managing digital campaigns, and representing SMS Clinical Research professionally in the community.

Position Details

* **Location:** Mesquite, TX
* **Position Type:** Full-time or part-time, depending on experience and organizational needs
* **Compensation:** Competitive and commensurate with experience

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume to info@smsclinicalresearch.com and, if available, examples of social media campaigns, advertisements, landing pages, or other marketing projects they have developed.

Join SMS Clinical Research and help connect our community with opportunities to participate in medical research and advance healthcare.

**Company Description**

**About M3:** A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

**M3 USA** is seeking a **Senior Manager, B2B Outbound Marketing** to develop and execute targeted outbound strategies across our portfolio of healthcare businesses.

This is a hands-on, strategically focused role centered on identifying the right business decision-makers, building targeted prospect audiences, and generating qualified sales conversations through personalized, multichannel outreach.

You will work closely with sales and marketing leadership across multiple business units to develop buyer personas, build outreach campaigns using email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement platforms, and continuously optimize performance to drive measurable pipeline growth.

This is not a traditional digital advertising or paid media position. We are looking for a B2B marketing professional with demonstrated experience building and executing outbound programs that connect sales teams with qualified prospective customers.

* Run multi-channel outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn and other social and digital channels, tailored by subsidiaries, with messaging that speaks to a targeted audience.
* Coordinate efforts with email deliverability specialists for all outbound email domains: authentication and IP warming, sender reputation monitoring, inbox placement testing, list hygiene, and compliance with Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft sender requirements, to reach corporate inboxes protected by enterprise filters.
* Systematize a cross-subsidiary strategy that converts M3's proprietary data assets, such as a network of physicians or health-system relationships— into a repeatable pipeline of qualified conversations through referrals and warm introductions.
* Use AI-assisted research and personalization: build account and contact intelligence, generate personalization at scale, test and refine messaging, while maintaining M3 human review and brand standards.
* Partner with the business development and marketing leads of each subsidiary on target account lists, handoff criteria, follow-up cadence, and feedback on message performance;
* Operate designated BU’s technology stack for outreach (sequencing, Sales Navigator,), integrate it with their CRM’s and recommend new or advanced tech tools.
* Report weekly on placement, reply and positive-reply rates, and pipeline sourced by subsidiary and persona, and use the data to retire what does not work and scale what does.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Certifications in email deliverability, sequencing platforms, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator preferred.
* 7+ years in B2B digital outreach, demand generation, or sales development, with at least 3 years owning persona marketing for outbound commercial revenue generation
* Demonstrated success reaching senior decision makers in healthcare, health systems, experience selling recruitment, staffing, or physician placement services strongly preferred.
* Hands-on experience with sequencing platforms (e.g., Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot Sequences), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, contact enrichment and verification tools, deliverability monitoring tools, and CRM integration.
* Experience supporting or consulting for multiple business units, clients or brands with distinct customers.
* Working knowledge of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), domain and IP warming, reputation monitoring, and inbox placement testing, and of how Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, Mimecast, and similar filters treat outbound mail.
* Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and hold a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume.
* Understanding of how health systems, medical groups, and staffing firms recruit physicians, and who own those decisions
* Strong writing skills: short, specific with the ability to adapt voice by persona and by subsidiary brand.
* Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR/UK GDPR, TCPA, and LinkedIn terms of service as they apply to outbound outreach.
* Ability to use AI tools for research, personalization, and testing, with judgment about accuracy, brand, and disclosure.
* Ability to manage several concurrent programs independently, prioritize across businesses, and report clearly to sales and marketing leaders.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

About The Wells Michael Collective

The Wells Michael Collective is an independent luxury real estate brokerage in Ladue, Missouri, led by partners Justin Michael and Suzie Wells. We represent significant homes across St. Louis and present them through architecture, design and the lives lived inside them.

The role

You will be the creative voice of The Wells Michael Collective across every screen and every printed page. You will own our social presence from concept to camera to caption, build the content strategy behind it, and design the brochures, mailers and campaigns that put our homes and our people in front of the right audience.

You will sit at the table with both partners and shape how the brand looks and sounds as it grows. Your ideas will move from sketch to published within days, with no agency layers or committee approvals in between. This is an in office and in field position, split between our Ladue office and shoots, listings and events across St. Louis.

What you will own

**Social media production and publishing**

* Plan, shoot, edit and publish content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube
* Produce short form video, reels and stories for every listing, from Coming Soon through Sold
* Direct photographers and videographers on set so every shoot matches the brand
* Write captions with an editorial voice: precise, warm and free of real estate clichés
* Manage the posting calendar, community replies and direct messages

**Content strategy**

* Build and run a monthly content strategy tied to listings, market moments, advisors and the St. Louis lifestyle
* Track performance every month and turn the numbers into next month's plan
* Develop recurring series that give people a reason to follow us: home stories, architecture, neighborhoods, design
* Grow audience quality as well as audience size, with the goal of reaching the clients who buy and sell significant homes

**Brand design**

* Design listing collateral in Canva: brochures, feature sheets, postcards, mailers and presentation pieces
* Keep every asset on brand using our Canva Brand Kit, palette and typography
* Prepare print files with correct bleed and specs for our print partners
* Build InDesign layouts for longer editorial pieces as the brand expands

**Brand expansion**

* Launch new advisors with a polished public profile and content plan
* Support press, magazine ads, events and community partnerships
* Help build the visual playbook that will carry the brand into new markets

What you bring

**Required**

* 3+ years producing social content and design work for a brand, ideally in luxury, hospitality, fashion, design or real estate
* Advanced Canva skills, with a portfolio that proves it
* An eye for elevation: you know the difference between expensive and significant, and your work shows restraint
* Strong photo and video skills on a phone and in an editing app such as CapCut, Premiere Rush or Lightroom
* Clear, polished writing with a natural editorial voice
* Comfort with analytics on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn
* Organized, self directed and able to run a calendar with many moving parts
* Based in St. Louis and able to be on site at shoots, events and the Ladue office

**A plus**

* Adobe InDesign, Photoshop or Illustrator
* Experience with print production and working with print vendors
* Experience directing photographers, videographers or stylists
* A following or portfolio built around architecture, interiors or St. Louis

Please include a portfolio. We hire on the strength of the work.

Growth path

This role is designed to grow into the head of marketing as the company grows. The path is tied to results, and you will review progress with both partners every quarter.

* **Marketing & Brand Content Manager.** Own social, content strategy and listing design. Build the systems and the calendar.
* **Senior Brand Manager.** Lead campaigns, press and partnerships. Manage freelance photographers, videographers and designers.
* **Director of Marketing & Brand.** Lead a marketing team, own the brand budget and guide the brand into new markets.

You will also receive an annual professional development budget for courses, conferences and creative tools, plus direct mentorship from two partners who have built a luxury brand from the ground up.

Compensation, bonus and benefits

* **Base salary:** based on experience and portfolio
* **Annual bonus:** tied to company growth milestones you helped drive
* **Paid time off:** PTO and major holidays, with a quiet week between Christmas and New Year's
* **Professional development:** an annual budget for courses, conferences and creative tools
* **Your tools (provided by the company):** a laptop, Canva Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud and the gear you need to shoot
* **Access:** a front row seat inside some of the most significant homes in St. Louis, and direct connection to the clients, designers, architects, builders and community leaders who shape them, with real networking opportunities through our events and partnerships

How to apply

Send your resume, a portfolio link and three pieces of work you are proudest of to team@wellsmichael.com. Tell us in a few sentences what you would change first about our Instagram. We read every application, and finalists will complete a short paid creative exercise.

Newton Motor Group is seeking a creative, organized Marketing Generalist to execute marketing initiatives across our dealerships. This hands-on role supports vehicle sales, service, and parts through content creation, digital marketing, promotional campaigns, and community events.

The CyteFinder®, AccuCyte®, and RarePlex® products enable class leading rare cell detection for liquid biopsy.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer with a strong scientific background and experience marketing to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and academic clinical research audiences. This individual will independently manage content development from research and subject matter expert interviews through writing, editing, publication, and optimization with the ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, differentiated content across digital marketing channels.

jobs.title: Technical SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

DynamiX is seeking an in-office Technical SEO Specialist to improve organic visibility, technical website performance, and AI-search readiness across a portfolio of client websites.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how websites are built, how search engines evaluate them, and how to turn technical findings into practical improvements. You will work closely with our web, content, marketing, and client teams to identify opportunities, resolve issues, and help clients become more visible in traditional and AI-driven search.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct technical SEO audits, identify issues, and prioritize clear recommendations.
* Improve site crawlability, indexing, page speed, mobile usability, internal linking, redirects, and site architecture.
* Implement and validate on-page SEO elements, including metadata, headers, image optimization, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and structured data.
* Help optimize websites and content for AI-driven search experiences, including generative search results and answer-focused discovery.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Screaming Frog, and SEO platforms to monitor performance and uncover opportunities.
* Partner with designers, developers, content creators, and project teams to ensure SEO is incorporated into website builds, redesigns, and ongoing improvements.
* Review website content and page structure for keyword alignment, user intent, clarity, and conversion opportunities.
* Create concise client-facing reports and explain recommendations in straightforward, actionable terms.
* Stay current on search-engine updates, AI-search trends, and evolving best practices.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical SEO, website optimization, or closely related digital marketing experience.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, CMS platforms, website architecture, and how these affect search performance.
* Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Screaming Frog, and SEO research or monitoring tools.
* Experience implementing or guiding schema markup and structured data.
* Familiarity with AI tools and AI-search optimization practices.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple client priorities and collaborating across teams.
* Agency or multi-client experience is a plus.

**Details**

This is a full-time, in-office role based in the Cobb County metro area/Kennesaw. Compensation will be based on experience, technical depth, and overall role fit, and will be discussed during the interview process.

**About DynamiX**

Interested in joining an amazing team of elite web professionals? DynamiX is a custom web house headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia (northwest of Atlanta). We are an *Inc 5000 Fastest Growing Company*, a *Top 25 Small Business* in Cobb County for 7 years running, and have received over 1,300 awards for our sites. We're obsessed with helping our clients win, and we love doing it! We value our team and want them to grow and thrive both personally and professionally. We do this by cultivating a sense of community and family as well as having a generous benefits package, including 401k, and great health benefits. If you are interested in working at a fast-paced, exciting and growing company, we are excited to meet and connect with you.

Our mantra is "Do it right, or don't do it". If you're eager to build great things, never settle for "just okay" and learn a lot more than you expected, then you may be just who we are looking for as we grow our team!

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Wag! Group Co. strives to be the number one platform to solve the service, product, and wellness needs of the modern U.S. pet household. Wag! pioneered on-demand dog walking in 2015 with the Wag! app, offering access to 5-star dog walking, sitting, and one-on-one training from a community of over 500,000 Pet Caregivers nationwide. Additionally, Wag! Group Co. operates Petted, one of the nation’s largest pet insurance comparison marketplaces; Dog Food Advisor, a leading pet food review platform; WoofWoofTV, reaching over 18 million followers with delightful pet content on social media; and maxbone, a digital platform for modern pet essentials, offering superfoods for dogs and stylish, functional products for today’s pet owners. For more information about our company, visit Wag.co. and wagwalking.com

  

**The Role**

Wag! is seeking a results-driven Director of SEO & SEM to lead our organic and paid search acquisition strategies. You will own search visibility, customer acquisition, and performance across Google, Bing, AI-powered search platforms, and other emerging discovery channels. The ideal candidate combines deep technical SEO expertise with hands-on paid search experience, using data, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration to drive profitable customer growth.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Search Strategy & Growth
  + Own the SEO and SEM strategy, roadmap, and execution to drive customer acquisition, bookings, and revenue.
  + Optimize performance across organic search, paid search, local SEO, and AI-driven discovery (GEO/LLMO).
  + Manage budgets, forecasting, and performance targets across paid and organic channels.
* SEO & Organic Growth
  + Lead technical, on-page, and off-page SEO, including site architecture, crawlability, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and link acquisition.
  + Develop scalable, intent-driven content and landing page strategies for dog walking, sitting, boarding, and related services.
  + Drive local SEO visibility across thousands of geographic markets and service-specific pages.
  + Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize and implement SEO improvements.
* SEM & Paid Acquisition
  + Own Google Ads and Microsoft Ads strategy, including campaign structure, keyword targeting, bidding, creative, and landing page optimization.
  + Optimize acquisition efficiency against CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
  + Lead experimentation across bidding strategies, ad copy, audience targeting, and conversion funnels.
  + Identify opportunities to improve combined organic and paid search performance.
* Analytics & Leadership
  + Establish KPIs, dashboards, and attribution frameworks to measure search-driven acquisition, bookings, and profitability.
  + Leverage GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, and SEO platforms to identify growth opportunities.
  + Manage agency partners, external vendors, and internal resources.
  + Communicate performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

  

**Minimum Paw-lifications**

* 8+ years of experience in SEO, SEM, and/or performance marketing
* Proven success scaling organic and paid search acquisition for consumer-facing digital businesses
* Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, local SEO, and evolving AI search experiences
* Advanced experience with Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO research platforms
* Strong analytical background with demonstrated ability to optimize CAC, LTV, ROAS, and conversion funnels

* Ability to work in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office

  

**Purr-furred Paw-lifications**

* Marketplace, consumer services, and/or high-growth technology experience
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Creative teams

  

**Benefits & Purrr-ks**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Complimentary parking on-site at our downtown Miami office
* Catered breakfast and lunch daily
* Monthly Wellness Stipend, and credits for both Wag! and maxbone
* Life Insurance and Short- and Long-term Disability with Guardian
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Empower and employer match as defined by plan
* 11 company-paid holidays each year
* Flexible (no set limit) discretionary paid time off in accordance with the vacation policy outlined in our handbook and subject to your manager’s approval
* Employees are eligible for paid parental leave, up to 8 weeks for non-birthing parents and 14-16 weeks for birthing parents

Our plants are hand-grown in carefully controlled environments designed to minimize unwanted chemicals and pests, keeping the cultivation process as natural as possible every step of the way. To learn more about Trulieve and our mission, please visit www.trulieve.com

**Remote Work Available:** Yes

The Manager leads eCommerce merchandising across assigned Trulieve digital storefronts, using customer behavior, category, assortment, inventory, promotional, and performance data to improve how customers discover and shop products. This role owns digital store presentation, product discovery, category and promotional merchandising, storefront accuracy, and performance optimization.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead eCommerce merchandising across assigned digital storefronts, using category, assortment, and customer shopping data to determine how products are organized, prioritized, promoted, and discovered.

* Own product discovery and digital store presentation, including product ranking, categories and collections, navigation, filters, product linking, onsite search, and promotional placement aligned to state assortment, inventory, and business priorities.

* Optimize key customer entry points and landing pages as “mini stores,” ensuring customers entering the site are presented with relevant products, categories, promotions, and clear paths to continue shopping.

* Use Power BI, GA4, and storefront performance data to understand how customers shop, identifying opportunities across entry, product discovery, browse, search, add to cart, and checkout that can improve the shopping experience and conversion.

* Working with state leaders, align learnings clear merchandising actions pages to improve, navigation or linking changes, and promotional opportunities in partnership with Pricing & Promotions, Web Content, Retail, Product Information, CRO, and other cross-functional teams.

* Monitor & build weekly read-outs of insights related to digital merchandising KPIs and operating standards, including product discovery, add-to-cart, checkout completion, conversion, category and entry-page performance, product readiness, promotional accuracy, and storefront quality.

* Help transition the eCommerce merchandising team to the future operating model, setting priorities, QA standards, runbooks, escalation paths, and team responsibilities while preparing product data, taxonomy, merchandising rules, and promotional requirements for Akeneo PIM, Adobe Catalog Service, Talon.One, and Hyper.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Preferred (not required): Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree: Marketing, Advertising, and/ or Data/Business Analytics/Science

* 3-5+ of eCommerce experience, preferably in high-volume retail or CPG. Cannabis industry preferred.

* Proven track record in improving digital customer experiences and driving revenue through merchandising and conversion optimization (Analytics, A/B testing, Search, SEO, Deep links, Journeys)

* Strong understanding of mobile-first UX, performance metrics, A/B testing, and eCommerce platforms. Adobe Commerce/Magento/Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) preferred.

* Required Technology proficiency: Enterprise CX/UX/UI, CMS, PowerBI, AEM, CRM, eCommerce, GA, GTM or similar

* Project Management: ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

* Belief in relationship building and working as part of a team to achieve goals/results

* You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, thrive in matrix environments, and are adept at building relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.

jobs.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring an SEO Specialist to improve client search rankings, strengthen local visibility, and help websites attract relevant organic traffic. You'll review website performance, identify technical and content issues, manage local search listings, and use campaign data to guide ongoing improvements.

This role is suited to someone with at least two years of SEO experience who can work methodically, write clear recommendations, and understand that meaningful search improvements take time. You'll be expected to monitor campaigns consistently, respond promptly when problems arise, and report results accurately without making promises the data cannot support.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Audit client websites to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, indexing problems, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop practical optimisation plans based on website audits, keyword research, and client objectives.
* Manage local business listings, check profile accuracy, and monitor customer reviews.
* Research keywords and search intent to identify opportunities for new pages and existing content improvements.
* Prepare clear content briefs outlining page objectives, target keywords, search intent, and recommended content structure.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators.
* Use Google Search Console and appropriate SEO tools to investigate changes in performance and identify potential issues.
* Review page titles, meta descriptions, internal links, headings, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Track campaign progress and prepare reports explaining performance changes, completed work, and recommended next steps.
* Investigate ranking declines, traffic changes, indexing issues, and other problems that may affect campaign performance.
* Keep campaign records, audit findings, and performance data accurate and organised.
* Respond promptly to client and team enquiries, particularly when a campaign requires investigation or corrective action.
* Communicate progress, concerns, and realistic expectations clearly to the relevant stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* **At least 2 years of professional experience in SEO.**
* Practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimisation, and local SEO.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console and relevant SEO research, auditing, and tracking tools.
* Understanding of keyword research, search intent, website indexing, and organic search performance.
* Good writing skills and the ability to prepare clear content briefs and optimisation recommendations.
* Ability to interpret ranking and traffic data and explain what the figures do—and do not—demonstrate.
* Strong attention to detail when auditing websites, checking business listings, and reviewing performance reports.
* A methodical approach to investigating technical issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks or campaigns at once.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate updates.
* Patience and consistency when managing campaigns where results develop over time.

**What to Expect in the Role**

You'll be expected to track SEO activity carefully, check your findings before reporting them, and communicate honestly about campaign performance. When rankings or traffic change unexpectedly, you should investigate the possible causes and explain what is known, what remains uncertain, and what action is recommended.

SEO requires ongoing attention rather than one-time fixes. We value consistent optimisation, realistic expectations, and prompt communication when a technical issue or campaign concern needs attention.

**Working Arrangements**

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Location:** 135 Henry St, Dayton, Ohio 45403  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Highlight your SEO experience, website auditing skills, familiarity with Google Search Console, and work with local search campaigns. Include examples of SEO projects you've supported and the performance indicators you used to evaluate progress.

***This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.***  
*Please, no agencies/recruiters.*

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Own paid performance.** Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.
* **Drive technical SEO and conversion.** Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.
* **Build in Claude Code.** Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.
* **Measure what works.** Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.
* **Shape AI and review-site discoverability.** Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.
* **Support content and campaigns.** Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-basedoutbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, theability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more thanchecking every box.

* Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution
* Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results
* A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting
* Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization
* An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct
* A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers
* Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearl

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients
* A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup
* Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software
* Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels
* Experience with G2 or other product review platforms
* Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

* **Day 30:** Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.
* **Day 60:** Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.
* **Day 90:** Run a scaled, measurable ad program with a clear line from spend to MQLs, and a roadmap for what you will build next.

**INTERVIEW PROCESS**  
**STEP 1:** Hiring Managers  
**STEP 2**: BDR Manager  
**STEP 3**: Sales Leadership  
**STEP 4:** CRO/Executive  
**STEP 5:** Case study/Panel interview

**The Basics:**

* **Work Authorization:** This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Rootstock is not able to sponsor, extend, or transfer work visas for this position now or in the future — this includes but is not limited to H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, and OPT/STEM OPT extensions. Candidates who will require sponsorship at any point during their employment will not be considered.

Base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

**Description**

  
  

Team: RamseyTrusted - Real Estate & Tax

Please note that applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Location: Franklin, TN—on-site, relocation assistance available, flexible schedules available

A Little Bit About Us: You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Here's a Taste of Our Benefits:

* Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
* 401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
* Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
* On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
* Dependent care FSA
* Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!

Where and How You'd Work:  
Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do in This Role:  
Copy that moves people to act is rare, and this role produces it. You'll own the writing for a close-knit marketing squad that helps people find trusted experts who serve them well, crafting short-form pieces like emails, landing pages, paid ads, video scripts, and podcast promotions. You'll build campaigns alongside marketers, designers, and paid media specialists, test what works, and sharpen your craft with performance data. The work matters because the mission does: every message you write guides someone toward the right help at the right time.

You're Probably a Match If:

* You have 3+ years of professional experience writing marketing and advertising copy yourself, and a portfolio of short-form work to show for it.
* You write in a conversational, human voice and can flex your style across audiences, channels, and campaign types.
* You've written across paid and organic media, social, email, landing pages, and video scripts.
* Your copy drives measurable outcomes like engagement, conversions, and revenue.
* You use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your writing workflow and can share real examples of how.
* You thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional squad, give and receive feedback well, and don't shy away from healthy conflict.
* You start every project by understanding the business goal, not just the brief.

What Winning Looks Like:

* Writing brand-aligned copy that captures Ramsey's voice, strikes the right emotion, and moves people to take the next step.
* Partnering with marketing and paid media teammates to optimize copy based on performance data.
* Studying customer pain points, marketing journeys, and competitors so every project starts with a clear "why."
* Using AI to generate fresh ideas and check work against brand standards while keeping the thinking firmly your own.
* Holding your work with an open hand, welcoming feedback, and carrying what you learn from one project to the next.
* Contributing to a squad culture of shared ownership by collaborating openly, engaging in healthy conflict, and showing up as a trusted teammate.

Other Stuff to Know:  
We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

If Ramsey Solutions sounds like a workplace where you can get excited about Mondays, apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!
