jobs.title: Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
**About Eleanor Health**

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

**About the Role**

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

**Where we are**
----------------

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

**Where we are going**
----------------------

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

* **First —** Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
* **Second —** Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
* **Third —** Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

**The channels**
----------------

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

**How the funnel is shared**
----------------------------

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

**What this role is accountable for**
-------------------------------------

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

**What You'll Do**

**Paid Media Strategy & Performance**

* Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
* Own budget pacing and allocation across all five ch

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As Chief Marketing Officer, you will shape how DRMP identifies opportunities, builds client relationships, and wins work. In engineering consulting, growth depends on understanding client priorities, positioning technical expertise, and bringing the right team to each pursuit. You will connect marketing, business development, market intelligence, and communications into a coordinated strategy that supports profitable growth and lasting client relationships.

This role combines strategic influence with hands-on leadership. You will partner with firm and operational leaders to decide where to compete, develop client and pursuit strategies, and coach technical professionals to communicate their value. You will also build the marketing and business development team’s capability and strengthen DRMP’s market presence. The opportunity is to shape both the growth strategy and the practices that turn it into results.

### **What you will lead:**

**Growth Strategy and Market Intelligence**

* Partner with firm leadership to translate business goals into focused market, client, and growth plans. Recommend where to invest, expand, or redirect effort based on opportunity, competitive position, and delivery capability.
* Track client capital plans, funding programs, procurement activity, legislation, and competitors to identify opportunities early and build a qualified pursuit pipeline.
* Guide go/no-go decisions with a clear view of client relationships, competitive positioning, pursuit investment, and the firm’s ability to win and deliver.
* Use pipeline, win-rate, client-growth, and pursuit data to assess results, challenge assumptions, and adjust priorities with operational leaders.

**Pursuit Strategy and Winning Work**

* Lead strategy for major pursuits, from early positioning through RFQ/RFP responses and interviews. Shape differentiated win themes around client priorities and the firm’s technical strengths.
* Provide hands-on direction on critical proposals and qualifications packages, ensuring persuasive writing, clear value propositions, and consistent quality.
* Coach technical leaders and interview teams on client engagement, presentation strategy, messaging, team selection, and rehearsal.
* Lead win/loss debriefs and apply the findings to improve pursuit selection, proposal quality, interview performance, and future results.

**Client Development and Account Growth**

* Partner with client and technical leaders to develop key-account plans, deepen relationships, and identify needs before opportunities are formally advertised.
* Equip technical professionals to build client relationships, ask effective questions, and turn insight into practical account and pursuit actions.
* Identify opportunities to bring additional services and expertise to clients. Track continuing services contracts and subsequent task orders to help account teams convert awards into sustained work.
* Gather client feedback, assess relationship health, and work with account teams to address concerns and follow through on commitments.

**Brand and Strategic Communications**

* Translate complex technical expertise and project outcomes into a clear, differentiated market position and compelling client-facing content.
* Direct thought leadership, public relations, digital marketing, social media, awards, and industry events in support of priority markets and client relationships.
* Coach leaders and subject-matter experts to communicate credibly with clients and industry audiences through presentations, articles, and speaking opportunities.
* Partner with the Chief People Officer on internal messaging and change communications, helping leaders explain business priorities while supporting the CPO’s ownership of internal communications.

**Team Leadership and Business Partnership**

* Build, lead, and develop the marketing and business development teams, with clear priorities, ownership, resource allocation, and accountability for results.
* Create trusted partnerships with operational and technical leaders. Influence across offices and disciplines, challenge constructively, and align teams around shared growth priorities.
* Strengthen team knowledge of the firm’s services, clients, and commercial priorities. Develop the team’s ability to advise pursuit and account leaders.
* Improve pursuit processes, CRM discipline, and knowledge sharing so teams can work consistently, use client intelligence, and adopt more effective ways of winning work.

  

### **What you bring:**

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 8+ years of progressive marketing, business development, or growth leadership experience in AEC, engineering consulting, environmental consulting, or a closely related technical professional services business. Comparable impact and scope will be considered.
* Experience leading a marketing or business development function, region, or business unit. Senior Directors and Vice Presidents ready for a broader remit are encouraged; a prior CMO title is not required.
* A measurable record of improving pursuit outcomes, client growth, or market position, with clear examples of personal ownership and partnership with technical leaders.
* Strong AEC pursuit expertise, including qualifications-based selection, RFQ/RFP strategy, proposal development, interview coaching, and pre-positioning. Able to connect marketing strategy with client development and winning work.
* Success leading and developing teams across offices, disciplines, or a matrixed organization, and coaching technical professionals in client engagement and business development.
* Strong commercial judgment, persuasive writing and presentation skills, and experience translating technical expertise into compelling positioning and communications.
* High emotional intelligence and credibility with senior leaders. Able to influence without direct authority, navigate resistance, and lead adoption of new processes while maintaining strong relationships

jobs.title: Email Marketing Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
About Future Finance

Future Finance is building the next generation of financial media: a daily newsletter that makes markets, investing, economics, and wealth creation engaging, actionable, and easy to understand for a modern audience.

Our goal is simple: become a daily habit for ambitious professionals who want to become smarter investors and better-informed consumers of financial information.

We're not going to out-spend our way to an audience. We're going to out-think, out-create, and out-connect everyone else in this space.

The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented assistant to support the day-to-day execution of our email marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

This is primarily an execution and operations role, not a copywriting or strategy role. Your responsibility will be to ensure campaigns are loaded, checked, scheduled, and sent accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Load and schedule 7 Future Finance campaigns per week on ActiveCampaign / Iterable (free newsletter).
* Load and schedule 5 paid newsletter campaigns per week on Beehiiv.
* Assist with scheduling 1–2 daily email broadcasts for Decentralized Masters.
* Upload provided copy, subject lines, preview text, images, and links.
* Ensure campaigns are sent to the correct audience segments at the correct times.
* Thoroughly QA emails before scheduling, including formatting, links, tracking, segmentation, and send settings.
* Maintain campaign calendars and trackers.
* Flag missing information, inconsistencies, or potential mistakes before campaigns go live.
* Assist with last-minute scheduling changes when needed.
* Schedule/segment SMS broadcasts as we roll out SMS campaigns

  
**Requirements**  
  
Who You Are

Attention to detail is the #1 priority for this role. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can be trusted to execute accurately without constant supervision.

Key qualities:

* Excellent attention to detail: Catches mistakes in links, formatting, targeting, scheduling, Messaging (user experience), etc.
* Ownership and good judgment: Doesn't blindly follow instructions. Proactively flags anything that looks incorrect or unusual and asks questions when needed.
* Reliability: Consistently meets deadlines and ensures campaigns are ready on time.
* Organization: Can manage multiple brands, campaigns, and schedules without letting things slip.
* Ability to follow processes: Comfortable working with SOPs, checklists, and established workflows.
* Proactive communication: Flags blockers early rather than waiting until the last minute.
* Independent execution: Can take responsibility for recurring tasks after training.
* Tech-savvy and trainable: Comfortable learning new software and picking up tools quickly.

Experience Requirements

Prior experience with email marketing platforms is NOT required. We're happy to train the right person.

Experience with ActiveCampaign, Iterable, Beehiiv, or similar email marketing platforms is a plus, but what matters most is being detail-oriented, reliable, tech-savvy, and a fast learner.

What You Won't Be Responsible For

* Writing email copy or subject lines

A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making

**Reporting & Dashboards**

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.

jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Associate Director of Marketing

**REPORTS TO:** Executive Director of Marketing

**EXPECTED SALARY RANGE:** $65,000 – 75,000; plus The University of Vermont Foundation’s progressive benefits package, which includes a comprehensive health plan; dental, vision, and life insurance; a robust paid time off package; a 403(b) plan with immediate vesting and contributions; and tuition remission.

**EFFECTIVE DATE:** November 15, 2026, or a mutually agreed-upon start date

**FTE:** Full-Time

**LOCATION:** Burlington, Vermont

**JOB-TYPE/HOURS:** Hybrid. The UVM Foundation operates on a 3-2 hybrid schedule which allows employees to work 2 days per week from a local remote location. Specific schedules are discussed with and approved by supervisors.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Associate Director of Marketing for Digital Communication Platforms manages the organization's website, email marketing, and text messaging platforms to advance the philanthropic and alumni engagement missions of the UVM Foundation and UVM Alumni Association. This role serves as the organization's primary subject matter expert for digital communications platforms, ensuring content is strategic, audience-focused, data-informed, and aligned with organizational goals.

Reporting to the Executive Director of Marketing, the Associate Director is responsible for the administration, optimization, governance, and ongoing enhancement of the Foundation's digital communication channels, including the website, email marketing platform, and texting platform. The position provides strategic guidance and technical support to colleagues across the organization while leveraging analytics and best practices to improve engagement, user experience, and campaign performance.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**40%** Manage, Update, and Optimize the UVM Foundation website

* Serve as primary administrator for the UVM Foundation website, overseeing content updates, site structure, accuracy, functionality, accessibility, and user experience while aligning with brand standards.
* Collaborate with marketing colleagues and content owners across the organization to create, update, and publish website content across the organization.
* Monitor website performance and user behavior using Google Analytics and platform reporting tools; collect data and provide recommendations to improve engagement and conversion outcomes.
* Lead ongoing efforts to enhance website usability, accessibility, search engine optimization (SEO), and overall user experience.
* Develop and maintain website governance processes, content standards, workflows, and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve landing pages, donation pathways, event registration experiences, and other high-priority user journeys.
* Troubleshoot website issues and coordinate with vendors or technical partners as needed to ensure optimal platform performance.

**40%** Manage, Maintain, and Optimize Email Marketing

* Serve as primary administrator and subject matter expert for the organization's email marketing platform.
* Develop and maintain email marketing standards, templates, processes, and best practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Build and deploy email communications and sequences while providing guidance and strategic support to staff responsible for creating and sending their own messages.
* Collect and review email performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve open rates, click-through rates, audience engagement, and conversion outcomes.
* Develop audience segmentation strategies that deliver more relevant and targeted communications.
* Establishing and enacting thoughtful data maintenance and hygiene processes, including conducting A/B performance testing, as well as creating dashboards or other reporting mechanisms to help stakeholders evaluate campaign effectiveness in service of making data-informed decisions. Ensure compliance with applicable privacy, consent, and email marketing regulations and best practices.
* Monitor emerging trends and technologies in email marketing and implement enhancements where appropriate.

**15%** Manage, Maintain, and Optimize Texting

* Serve as administrator for the organization's texting platforms and help establish a long-term strategy for text-based engagement.
* Develop processes, standards, and best practices governing the use of SMS communications across the organization.
* Partner with fundraising, alumni engagement, and event teams to expand texting initiatives to include event reminders, volunteer engagement, stewardship, and other strategic communications.
* Monitor engagement and response metrics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for growth.
* Ensure compliance with applicable consent, privacy, and communication requirements.
* Develop reporting tools and recommendations that support continuous improvement of texting efforts.

**5****%** Other duties as assigned

**MINIMUM SKILLS & ABILITIES**

* Experience managing content within a website content management system (CMS).
* Experience creating, deploying, and evaluating email marketing campaigns.
* Experience using analytics tools to measure performance and inform decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Design sensibilities preferred and experience adhering to branding guidelines.
* Collaborative approach to working across teams.
* Demonstrated commitment to the principles of diversity, equity and inclusion, combined with the ability to meaningfully apply those principles to strategy development and implementation.

  

**PREFERRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree and at least 2-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital communications, email marketing, website management, and/or experience from which comparable knowledge, skill, and abilities have been developed.

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, this position provides senior-level leadership across E-Commerce, Brand, Creative, Marketing Operations, and related marketing functions, ensuring that the department operates as a cohesive, accountable, and results-driven organization.

The Director of Marketing must possess a strong understanding of digital acquisition, paid media performance, return on advertising spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion rate optimization, retention marketing, and the financial drivers of a successful e-commerce business.

jobs.title: Receptionist/Administrative Assistant Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
**Fair warning: this is not a “sit at the desk” job.**

At 9am you might be checking in a patient who’s nervous about their first treatment. At 10:30 you’re on the phone with a doctor’s office about an order. By noon you’re picking up dry ice because a shipment goes out today. By 3 you’re posting on Instagram or updating a page on our website. Next month? You could be at a conference, shaking hands with med spa owners who want what we’ve got.

If that sounds chaotic, this isn’t your job.

If that sounds *fun*, keep reading.

**Who we are**

The Stem Cell Club helps people dealing with joint pain, injuries, and life’s wear and tear explore regenerative medicine. ATOM Stem Cells, our sister company, supplies stem cell products to clinics across the country.

Same team. Two companies. Growing fast in Vegas, St. George, and nationwide.

**The hats you’ll wear**

* **Patient Hat.** Answer calls and texts, call back new leads, greet patients, check them in and out, and follow up after treatment so nobody feels forgotten.
* **Computer Hat.** Keep patient records spotless in our CRM, confirm appointments, and track follow-ups. If it’s not in the system, it didn’t happen.
* **Social Media Hat.** Create and post content on our social channels. Patient stories (with permission), behind-the-scenes moments, and stuff from our content calendar.
* **Website Hat.** Update pages, put up new content, and help build out websites as we grow.
* **Doctor Hat.** Visit with physicians and partner clinics, help with ATOM orders, and be the friendly face of the brand.
* **Logistics Hat.** Dry ice runs, shipment prep, and making sure the cells get where they need to go, cold and on time.
* **Road Trip Hat.** Conferences, trade shows, and meetings with med spas and clinics.
* **Whatever’s Next Hat.** We’re growing, and new hats show up every month. You’ll get first dibs.

**Don’t know how to do half of that? Good. Neither did we.**

We’ll train you on all of it: the CRM, social media, websites, the products, the science. You don’t need to show up knowing everything. You need to show up willing to learn it.

**What we can’t train**

A smile. A good attitude. The kind of person who’s genuinely happy to be here.

That’s the whole job, honestly. Our patients are often in pain and nervous, and a warm, happy face at the front desk changes their entire experience. Doctors and clinics feel it too. Skills we can teach. Happy, we hire.

**Let’s be real about the pace**

It gets busy. Phones ring, shipments are due, a patient needs something *right now*. Some days are stressful.

But here’s how we see it: it’s just work. We take care of people seriously, and we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Nobody here is going to lose their mind over a missed call. We figure it out, we laugh about it, and we keep moving.

**You’ll crush it here if you…**

* Smile without being told to (people can hear it on the phone, too)
* Say “I’ve got it” before anyone asks
* Can switch from a patient to a physician to a FedEx counter without missing a beat
* Love learning new things, especially tech
* Want to grow *with* a company, not just collect a paycheck from one
* Have a sense of humor (required, non-negotiable)

**You won’t love it here if you…**

* Think “that’s not my job” is a complete sentence
* Need every day to look the same
* Let a busy day ruin your whole week

**What you get**

* Full training on everything: CRM, social media, websites, products, and more
* A real shot at growing into a bigger role as we expand. The people who start here are the ones who’ll lead later.
* A front-row seat to one of the fastest-moving fields in medicine
* A small team where your work actually gets noticed

**Nice to have (not required):** medical office or front desk experience, bilingual English/Spanish

**How to apply**

Send your resume or call us.

Pay: $15.00 - $22.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Social Media Specialist at Ink'd Stores

Location: Foxborough, MA studio / Hybrid  
Type: Full-time

**Who we are**

Ink'd makes custom merch, from people who care.

We do custom apparel, company merch stores, and kits for brands like DoorDash and Crocs, plus 1,000+ companies, schools, and nonprofits. Everything gets spec'd, printed, packed, and shipped from our own floor in Massachusetts. We've printed more than a million items, we hit 99.8% of our dates, and every box ships with a handwritten note and a little duck.

We started in 2015 as a 45-day pop-up and stayed for years. No shortcuts. We just kept picking up the phone. We don't do "swag for the sake of swag." We make things people actually want to wear.

**The role**

You'll be the voice of Ink'd online. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and everything else: the content, the calendar, the community and the paid ads. You'll turn a busy print floor and a 10-year founder story into posts that get people to stop scrolling, and you'll turn those posts into leads.

This is not a "schedule three posts a week" job. It's for a hungry self-starter who wants to own a channel, ship fast, learn faster, and see their work show up in the pipeline. Early-career candidates are welcome. We care about drive and talent more than years on a résumé.

**What you'll do**

Own the feeds. Plan and run the content calendar on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok (X and YouTube too). Every channel gets its own voice, and all of it sounds like Ink'd.

Make the content. Shoot and edit short-form video and photos on the floor: presses running, kits getting packed, logos on Lululemon and Patagonia, finished drops landing. Write captions that sound like a person, not a promo catalog.

Run the ads. Build, launch and optimize paid social campaigns (Meta, plus LinkedIn as we grow) aimed at the people who buy merch: HR, people-ops, marketing and office leaders. Test, read the numbers, cut what's not working and scale what is.

Tell the story. Turn Jay's Blog, client wins, new-hire kits and seasonal drops into posts, reels and carousels.

Work LinkedIn. Grow the company page and help amplify the founder's voice where our B2B buyers actually spend their time.

Listen and engage. Reply to comments and DMs, watch what competitors and the promo industry are doing, and spot trends early.

Measure everything. Track reach, engagement, traffic and leads with native analytics and Google Analytics. Report what worked, what didn't, and what you'll try next.

Keep it on-brand. Work with our team on messaging, client features, and protecting our reputation online.

**What you bring**

Real social media experience: a brand, a business, a club, a creator account, or your own feed with results you can show us.

A strong eye for short-form video and the ability to shoot and edit it yourself (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or similar).

Tight, punchy writing. You can say it in five words when everyone else uses twenty.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, or the drive to get great at it fast.

Comfort with numbers. You know what CTR, CPM and CPL mean and you care when they move.

Ownership. You see something that needs doing and you do it without being asked.

Speed and organization. You can juggle a calendar, a shoot and an ad test in the same week.

**Nice to have**

Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) and/or Canva

A scheduling tool such as Hootsuite, Buffer, Later or Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn Ads and B2B social experience

SEO basics and social listening tools

Experience working with influencers or creators

Some familiarity with apparel, merch, printing or e-commerce, or just a love for good gear

**Why join**

You own it. Your ideas go live fast, and you'll see exactly what they do for the business.

There's a lot to film. Presses, embroidery, a million-plus items, and brands like Patagonia, Vuori and YETI coming off our floor.

Real people. A small, close team where everybody picks up the phone and owns the details.

Room to grow. We're growing, and the right person can grow this role into more.

Ink'd Stores is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

Pay: $15.00 - $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

**About Bizzabo**

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo. Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

**What you'll do**

* Own positioning and messaging for the Event Experience OS. Translate new agentic capabilities into clear, provable value for enterprise event leaders, and keep the story consistent from the website to the last call before signature.

* Help us win competitive deals. Own competitive intelligence against legacy event management platforms and newer point solutions. Build battlecards, landmine questions, and objection handling that reps actually use, and run win/loss analysis to sharpen them.
* Equip the field. Build the pitch narrative, demo storylines, one-pagers, and RFP content. Partner with Sales and Solutions leadership to train the team and make sure every new capability is sold, not just shipped.

* Own the context layer. Our messaging, product, and competitive knowledge powers the Claude Skills our teams use to write, sell, and support. You'll keep that source of truth current and use AI to automate your own GTM workflows.

**﻿What success looks like**

In your first 90 days:

* You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.
* You've refreshed our core competitive materials and the field is using them in live deals.
* You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.
* You've shipped your first launch end to end.

In your first year:

* Our competitive win rate is measurably higher, and you can show which of your work moved it.
* Every major release goes to market with a clear story, trained reps, and customer adoption plans.
* Our analyst and peer review position reflects where the product actually is.
* The messaging that powers our people and our AI agents is sharp, current, and trusted across the company.

**﻿What you need**

* 5+ years of product marketing in B2B SaaS selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including time as the lead or sole product marketer.
* An AI-native way of working. You've used AI agents, ideally Claude, to automate real GTM workflows, and you can show us what you built.
* A track record of positioning complex platforms for both business and technical buyers, and of winning against an entrenched incumbent.
* Strong sales enablement instincts. You build narratives and assets that get used in the field, and you know how to check that they do.
* Hands-on experience with analyst relations, ideally including a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.
* Excellent writing. You make complicated things simple without making them generic.
* Comfort building without a big team around you: you set your own priorities, move fast, and ship.

**﻿Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in your day-to-day work.
* Experience in event technology, martech, or another platform sold to marketing teams.
* Experience marketing agentic or AI-first products to enterprise buyers.
* Experience with a three-sided value story (in our case, organizers, attendees, and sponsors).
* Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, and comfort pulling your own data from them.

jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

**The Company**

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

**The Role**

The Senior Demand Generation Manager is responsible for driving sustainable long-term pipeline growth and market engagement across Versaterm's portfolio of public safety solutions. This role leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives through expertise and influence, and brings deep functional and technical mastery of demand generation. The Senior Demand Generation Manager frequently represents the marketing function in cross-departmental and external engagements, contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area, mentors others, and actively champions Versaterm's values across the teams and work they influence.

**About Scrunch**
=================

Scrunch, a Sitecore company, is on a mission to bring brands to an AI-first future—where people increasingly rely on LLMs to discover, understand, and act on information that matters to them.

As AI search and conversational agents replace traditional web search and browsing, Scrunch helps marketing teams rethink how their products and services are discovered and surfaced on AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more—working *with* AI platforms, not against them. This shift represents the biggest change to marketing since the dawn of the internet.

Today, more than 500 paying brands—including Fortune 500 companies like Lenovo, category-defining brands like Akamai, ADP, Lenovo and breakout startups like Clerk—use the platform.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Director of Product Marketing to establish and lead Product Marketing as a strategic business capability during a pivotal stage of growth for Scrunch.

This role is ideal for a self-starter who has introduced or matured Product Marketing within organizations where the function, processes, or expectations were not previously well defined. You will assess the business, identify the highest-value gaps, and create the strategy, operating rhythms, and deliverables needed to help Scrunch bring products to market effectively.

As the senior Product Marketing leader dedicated to Scrunch, you will connect Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Partners, and Sitecore leadership. You will influence product and go-to-market strategy, create structure where it adds value, and translate customer needs, market signals, and roadmap changes into a clear Product Marketing plan that stakeholders can execute.

This is a hands-on leadership role with significant ownership. You will personally lead critical strategic initiatives while helping shape how Product Marketing operates across the business. As the organization grows, there may be opportunities to mentor, develop, and potentially manage Product Marketing talent, making previous people leadership experience valuable.

**What You Will Do**

**Build the Product Marketing Capability**

* Establish Product Marketing as a strategic discipline within Scrunch and clarify how the function partners with Product, Marketing, Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, and Partners
* Assess the organization to identify gaps where Product Marketing can create the greatest leverage and business impact
* Define scalable Product Marketing practices, operating rhythms, decision frameworks, and stakeholder engagement models
* Operate as both a strategic leader and a hands-on contributor, driving execution while helping the organization mature its go-to-market capabilities
* Mentor and influence teammates across functions and, as the business evolves, potentially support the development or management of additional Product Marketing talent

**Drive Product and Go-to-Market Strategy**

* Own and evolve Scrunch product marketing strategy, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, audience definition, and go-to-market planning
* Partner with Product Management to help define roadmap priorities and navigate changes based on customer needs, competitive dynamics, and market signals
* Translate product strategy and roadmap priorities into a clear Product Marketing plan that Marketing, Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Partners, and other stakeholders can execute
* Serve as a voice of the market, customer, and buyer in product planning and business decisions

**Build Scalable Launch and Release Processes**

* Define and operationalize product release and launch processes across Scrunch and its Sitecore stakeholders
* Establish a release-tiering framework that aligns the significance of each release with the appropriate level of launch planning, marketing investment, seller readiness, and customer communication
* Partner with Product and Marketing to translate product releases into compelling campaigns, programs, and market-facing stories
* Create repeatable processes that improve launch quality, organizational readiness, speed, and measurable impact

**Enable Growth and Market Adoption**

jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a senior Growth leader to architect and operate our growth engine from the ground up — hands‑on. This isn't a "manage the agency" role. You'll be the one designing the system, wiring the stack, running the experiments, and shipping the assets. You think in funnels and frameworks, build measurement infrastructure before you launch campaigns, and treat go-to-market as an engineering discipline: instrument, test, iterate, scale.

You'll work directly with Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand to turn signal into pipeline — and you'll be the one who actually builds the things that make that happen. Critically, you'll own the number: net new business in the form of marketing qualified leads is your north star, and you'll be accountable for hitting it. This will be a high-visibility role with incredible growth opportunities.

**What You'll Do**

**Ad Engine Ownership & Performance Marketing**

* Own the design, build, and continuous optimization of our ad engine across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and video — with a focus on efficiency, scale, and measurable pipeline contribution.
* Architect audience segmentation, bidding strategies, creative rotation logic, and budget allocation frameworks to maximize return on ad spend.
* Move beyond channel management: treat the ad engine as a product, iterating on targeting logic, landing page pairings, offer variants, and conversion pathways to compound performance over time.
* Own hands‑on execution — you're in the platforms, not just reviewing reports.

**Driving Net New Business: MQL Ownership**

* Own the MQL number. You are directly accountable for generating net new marketing qualified leads that convert into pipeline and revenue.
* Build and operate the demand generation engine that fills the top of funnel — from first touch to sales-ready hand‑off — with clear SLAs, routing logic, and feedback loops.
* Define and enforce MQL quality standards in partnership with Sales and RevOps, continuously tightening the criteria as signal improves.
* Report on MQL volume, velocity, cost-per-MQL, and downstream conversion rates; use those inputs to direct investment across channels and programs.

**Scaling the Marketing Foundation: 1 to 100**

* Take the marketing foundations already in place — brand narrative, positioning, early channel presence, initial playbooks — and build the operational engine that scales them.
* Translate strategy into a repeatable growth system: standardized processes, campaign architecture, channel playbooks, and asset libraries that multiply output without multiplying headcount.
* Identify what's working at small scale and build the infrastructure — tooling, measurement, creative, ops — to run it at 10x without losing fidelity or efficiency.
* Close the gaps between brand and demand: ensure every scaled program reinforces positioning while driving measurable business outcomes.

**Full-Funnel Growth System Ownership**

* Design and own the full‑funnel growth architecture: paid (search, social, programmatic, video), organic (SEO, content, web), ABM, partnerships, and referral.
* Build the experimentation infrastructure — test frameworks, audience segmentation, offer variants, landing page scaffolding — and run rapid learning cycles.
* Engineer the demand‑to‑pipeline path: ICP definitions, routing logic, handoff SLAs, and Sales feedback loops.
* Identify new channels and build the playbook before you scale spend.

**Growth Stack & Analytics**

* Instrument the growth funnel end‑to‑end across Salesforce, HubSpot, GA4, Webflow/CMS, and attribution/BI tooling.
* Partner with RevOps and Analytics to establish taxonomy, data hygiene standards, experimentation frameworks, and attribution models that hold up under scrutiny.
* Build dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make the "what's working" question answerable in real time — and translate results into insights, next actions, and investment guidance for Marketing and GTM leaders.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Serve as the DRI for growth: set strategy, run the operating cadence, and align Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand around clear priorities and decision criteria.
* Build influence without line authority — turn cross‑functional stakeholders into an integrated growth squad.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap and experiment backlog; communicate trade‑offs and learnings frequently.

**What You Have**

* Senior, hands‑on experience building integrated growth programs in B2B SaaS; healthtech experience a plus.
* Demonstrated ownership of an MQL or pipeline number

jobs.title: Community & Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Community & Brand Manager**
=============================

**Company:** CyberNut

**Reports to:** CEO and VP of Marketing

**Location:** Los Angeles preferred (in-office; finding someone in LA is our ideal scenario). Remote within the US considered.

**Travel:** Frequent travel across the country to customer sites, school districts, and K-12 conferences

**Type:** Full-time

**About CyberNut**
------------------

CyberNut is a fast-growing K-12 cybersecurity startup protecting more than 1 million students and staff across hundreds of school districts. Schools are one of the most targeted sectors for phishing and ransomware, and most security training was built for corporate boardrooms, not classrooms. We built CyberNut for schools.

Our platform trains teachers, staff, and students to spot phishing, scams, and account compromise as they happen, not once a year. Districts get automated, always-on phishing simulations themed to the tools schools actually use, one-click threat reporting right from the inbox, and short, gamified lessons that take minutes instead of hours. Our squirrel mascot, acorn rewards, and school leaderboards have turned security training into something staff and students actually talk about.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Gen Z or millennial content creator who lives on social media and wants to build a brand people genuinely root for. You have native experience building, publishing, and creating content on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and you know what makes people stop scrolling.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role at a fast-growing startup. You will travel around the country to meet our districts, show up at conferences, film content on site, and turn customer love into customer engagement. You will be part community builder, part brand ambassador, and the voice and face of CyberNut on social.

Why it exists: many of our districts like the brand as much as they use the platform. Leaderboards get posted, swag gets worn at conferences, and IT directors call themselves "a CyberNut school." Nobody on the team is accountable for growing that energy on purpose. This role owns it.

You will report directly to our CEO and our VP of Marketing, and work closely with Customer Success.

**What you will own**
---------------------

Your time will split roughly across three areas: brand activation (about 35%), community and engagement (about 35%), and brand, social media, and content (about 30%). The split will flex by quarter.

### **1. Brand activation in every district**

Buying CyberNut is not the same as being a CyberNut school. Activation is the work of making the brand visible, felt, and owned inside a district, and it looks different for a 2,000-student rural district than for a 40,000-student suburban one.

* Build an activation plan for every new customer during onboarding, alongside their Customer Success Manager: who the champion is, where the brand will show up (staff kickoff, hallways, the IT newsletter, the board meeting), which program launches first, and what the district will be proud of in 90 days.
* Track the activation level of every existing account (dormant, launched, visible, owned), review the lowest tier with Customer Success each month, and bring a plan to move each account up.
* Create and ship the activation kit: launch decks for staff meetings, mascot and poster assets, leaderboard displays for IT offices and staff lounges, email templates for superintendents and principals, and swag for the first winners.
* Run the launch moment. The first leaderboard reveal or the first trophy delivery should be an event, not an email.
* Tailor the plan to each district. A single champion IT director needs a different plan than a district with a cabinet-level sponsor. The goal is the same: staff say "we're a CyberNut school" without being prompted.

### **2. Community and engagement**

* Run competitive leaderboard programs across customers: district vs. district, school vs. school, department vs. department. For example, a fall "Phish Bowl" where 25 districts compete on report rate for six weeks, with sponsored prizes and a trophy that travels.
* Design and ship recurring promotions and events: Cybersecurity Awareness Month kits, end-of-year awards, a "first 90 days" challenge for new customers, and a winter swag drop for top performers.
* Build and host customer community calls to learn which gamification loops drive the most excitement and engagement: a customer call where IT directors share what worked, and an online community space.
* Partner with Customer Success on low-engagement accounts. When participation is flat, you bring the activation play (a leaderboard launch, a principal challenge, a superintendent shout-out) instead of another reminder email.
* Make engagement visible outside the district. A school that climbs the leaderboard sees itself celebrated on CyberNut's channels the same week.

### **3. Brand ambassador, social media, and content**

You own CyberNut's social channels. We want CyberNut showing up everywhere: TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn. What Duolingo did with its owl, we want you to help us do with our squirrel.

* Own the company social accounts on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a weekly content calendar you run. Marketing sets brand guidelines and campaign priorities; you create, film, and publish the day-to-day content, about 4 to 5 posts a week, most of them built from what customers are doing.
* Bring the CyberNut squirrel to life as a personality people follow, with recurring formats, trends, and moments that make the mascot recognizable well beyond our customers.
* Get on camera. Film on site at districts and conferences, try new formats, and do fun, creative things that push the brand forward.
* Own the swag program end to end: what we make, who earns it, how it ships, and the budget. Think limited editions for top performers and referrers, not giveaways for everyone.
* Show up at regio

jobs.title: Director of Sales & Marketing / Physical Therapist
jobs.description:
**Join a team that puts people first and helps you rise**
=========================================================

At Peak Performance Physical Therapy, your work matters to your patients, your team, and your future. We’re committed to helping you reach your highest potential through mentorship, collaboration, and a culture built on compassion and excellence.

#### **Who We are**

##### **A People-First Culture**

Our story began with a simple belief: when people feel supported, they thrive. As part of a family of clinics dedicated to professional growth, clinical excellence, and real human connection, we foster an environment where you’re valued, encouraged, and empowered to do meaningful work daily.

#### **Our Purpose**

##### **Empowering lives through evidence-informed care**

Our mission is to help people move freely, feel better, and live fully. Every member of our team contributes to breaking down barriers to care through prevention, education, and long-term recovery strategies. If you’re passionate about making a real difference, you’ll feel at home here.

**Director of Sales and Marketing**
===================================

**Company:** Peak Performance Physical Therapy

**Position Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Reports To:** Chief Financial Operations Officer

**Position Overview**

The Director of Sales and Marketing is responsible for driving patient acquisition, building brand awareness, and growing revenue across Peak Performance Physical Therapy's Greater Lansing locations.

This position will develop and execute sales and marketing strategies to increase patient referrals, strengthen physician and community relationships, and position Peak Performance as the premier orthopedic and manual physical therapy provider in mid-Michigan.

Approximately 60% of the role will focus on sales and marketing, with the remaining 40% spent treating patients as a physical therapist at our Lansing clinic (two days per week).

The ideal candidate combines clinical knowledge, strong relationship-building skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, and a passion for growing the business while delivering excellent patient care.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Director will be responsible for developing Peak's sales and marketing strategy and personally executing key elements of that strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Referral Development & Relationship Management**

* Develop and manage a structured outreach program to physician practices, orthopedic surgeons, sports medicine providers, and other referral sources across the Greater Lansing area.
* Build and maintain strong, lasting relationships with referring providers, their office staff, and key healthcare system contacts to drive consistent and growing patient referral volume.
* Track referral source data, identify growth opportunities, and develop action plans to expand and diversify the referral network across all clinic locations.
* Represent Peak Performance at healthcare community events, networking functions, and professional associations throughout mid-Michigan.
* Conduct regular scheduled visits to high-priority referral sources and maintain a contact management system for all referral relationships and outreach activities.

**Digital Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute Peak Performance’s digital marketing strategy, including website content, search engine optimization (SEO), Google Ads, and social media channels across all locations.
* Manage the company’s online reputation, including Google Business profiles for each clinic location, patient review platforms, and brand consistency across all digital touchpoints.
* Create and distribute content that educates prospective patients, engages referring providers, and reinforces Peak Performance’s clinical expertise and patient outcomes.
* Coordinate with external vendors, designers, or agencies as needed for creative, digital, or media production support.
* Ensure consistent brand standards, messaging, and visual identity across all locations, marketing materials, and digital channels.

**Patient Acquisition & Market Growth**

* Identify and capitalize on market opportunities to grow new patient volume across all Peak Performance locations in the Greater Lansing area.
* Develop and execute community outreach initiatives, clinic sponsorships, health fairs, employer wellness partnerships, and athletic team or league relationships.
* Collaborate with clinical directors and front desk teams at each location to optimize the patient experience from first contact through initial visit conversion.
* Track new patient sources, marketing campaign performance, and conversion metrics to evaluate ROI and continuously improve strategy.

**Marketing Operations & Reporting**

* Manage the marketing budget effectively, allocating resources to highest-impact channels and activities.
* Develop and maintain marketing calendars, campaign plans, and promotional materials for all locations.
* Provide regular performance reports to the CFOO, including new patient volume trends, referral source analysis, digital marketing metrics, and campaign results.
* Coordinate internal communications, seasonal promotions, and announcements that support clinical team engagement and patient communication.
* Evaluate marketing technology platforms, tools, and systems to improve efficiency and measurement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities of Physical Therapist**

* Evaluate patients, identify physical impairments, and develop individualized treatment plans.
* Provide evidence-based therapeutic interventions to improve strength, mobility, balance, coordination, and functional abilities.
* Educate patients and families on therapeutic exercises, home exercise programs, and injury prevention.
* Monitor patient progress, modify treatment plans as needed, and document care accurately in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies.
* Collaborate with healthcare professionals

jobs.description:
**Brand Manager**

**Farmer Group | Cortland, NY (Hybrid, 3 days/week in office) | Full-time, Exempt**

**About Us**

Farmer Group is a fast-growing cannabis company and the home of five in-house brands: Florist Farms, Head & Heal, Blotter, Tune, and Hudson. We take pride in being a legitimate, well-run company in an industry where that's often missing, and we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

We're looking for an organized, collaborative Brand Manager to bring our brands to life. Reporting to the Brand Director, you'll turn brand priorities into well-run projects. jobs.title: Senior eCommerce Brand Manager, Private Label

Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. #### **Why Hershey:**

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. The Hershey Company is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

  

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

  

Guided by our employee value proposition, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our One Hershey mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

  

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

Kit Kat is one of the world’s most recognizable and distinctive brands, and this role will shape both what the brand stands for and how the business grows. As Senior Brand Manager, Kit Kat, you will be the vision maker and business leader for the brand, setting long-term ambition, strategic direction, creative expression, portfolio choices, and commercial growth agenda while protecting and strengthening brand health. At the same time, you will own the performance narrative for the business, using rigorous tracking and analysis to identify opportunities, make clear choices, and drive action. You will offer portfolio oversight and influence the innovation pipeline, ensuring that near- and long-term growth opportunities are consumer-led, financially sound, and executable. You will serve as the brand voice in critical creative, media, portfolio, and investment decisions; lead the integrated agency team; oversee design evolution; and unlock incremental brand equity and demand through Away From Home, Seasons & Tentpoles, and other high-impact occasions. **What will you do?**

* Define and champion the long-term vision, growth strategy, positioning, and business direction for Kit Kat, translating enterprise priorities, consumer insight, and marketplace dynamics into clear choices for the brand
* Lead portfolio strategy and management, making choices across formats, pack-price architecture, and channels to maximize sustainable growth and brand coherence
* Own brand health and equity, establishing the learning agenda and turning consumer, cultural, competitive, and marketplace signals into strategies that strengthen relevance and distinctiveness
* Serve as the creative tip of the spear, setting the creative ambition and leading insurgent-mindset marketing across Masterbrand equity and growth initiatives that make Kit Kat more distinctive, relevant, and iconic
* Lead the integrated agency team and partner with Creative, Media, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver breakthrough, insight-led work that connects strategy to execution and expands demand
* Act as the brand voice in critical creative, media, portfolio, and investment decisions, balancing brand-building impact, commercial priorities, marketing effectiveness learnings, and financial stewardship
* Own the brand’s performance narrative through disciplined tracking, business analysis, and forecasting; identify drivers, risks, and opportunities and mobilize cross-functional action to deliver business objectives
* Collaborate closely with the Commercial team to translate brand strategy and annual plans into customer- and channel-relevant programs, ensuring execution pulls through to drive conversion at the moment of choice.
* Unlock incremental brand equity and demand through Away From Home, Seasons & Tentpoles, and other strategic platforms, with clear success measures and disciplined resource allocation.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Experience:**

* 6+ years of relevant experience in Brand Management, Marketing, Innovation, Strategy, Media, or Creative
* Consumer Product experience required; food experience preferred
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying both long-term brand strategy and annual brand plans, grounded in consumer insight

It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.

* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.

* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. jobs.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

At HackerOne, great content starts with a great story. It’s how we make complex cybersecurity topics understandable, turn original research into insights people remember, and build trust with security leaders.

As our Content Marketing Manager, you’ll help find and tell those stories. You’ll lead key parts of our content program, including the HackerOne blog, annual research, search optimization, and editorial standards. You’ll work with experts across HackerOne to uncover interesting ideas, find the story in the data, and turn technical expertise into content that is clear, useful, and worth reading.

This role is part editor, part storyteller, and part content strategist. You’ll bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, and an audience-first mindset to what we create, while using data, search insights, and AI tools to help our content reach the right people and make a measurable impact.

* Find stories across HackerOne by interviewing subject matter experts, asking the right questions, and identifying perspectives that can strengthen our thought leadership.
* Turn complex cybersecurity topics into clear, engaging content for security leaders without losing the substance or expertise behind them.
