**About AIOS**
==============

**AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.**  
We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.  
We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.  
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

* The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.
* The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

* **Step 0 $100M/yr by end of 2025**: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.
* **Step 1 $1B ARR by end of 2026**: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.
* **Step 2 $10B ARR by end of 2028**: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.
* **Step 3 $100B/yr by end of 2031**: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.
* **Step 4 $1T/yr by end of 2035**: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.  
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

**Being a Senior Media Buyer at AIOS**
--------------------------------------

We are building a world-class team.

As Senior Media Buyer (Paid Search) at Aios, your mission is to unlock Google as a major growth channel, taking it from a small share of our paid mix today to a mature, scaled second engine that runs alongside Meta.

Google is our biggest under-tapped opportunity. Non-brand spend today is small relative to what the account can support, and our plan is to close the gap to Meta significantly across the year (>£1m/month).

Your job is to architect and drive that scale-up: growing spend profitably, without blowing out CAC, and without ever cutting corners on the strict ASA and CAP compliance rules that govern what we can say in ad copy (Rule 12.12 in particular).

Early on, you'll ramp into the accounts: current campaign structure, keyword strategy, tCPA dynamics, Search Abs Top IS, ad copy inside compliance constraints, feed setup on Shopping, and how each market behaves. As trust builds, you'll take on increasing ownership of the Google operation end-to-end.

This is not a strategy-only role. The work today is hands-on craft inside Google Ads. Over time, the ceiling is much higher: you'll lead the Google pod, take on EU markets as they launch (Germany, Netherlands, Portugal, Denmark, Sweden), and expand into adjacent channels as you earn the right.

Great performance means Google spend scales while CAC holds or improves, Search Abs Top IS climbs materially, tCPA campaigns get pushed to their real ceilings without breaking, new markets launch cleanly without hurting UK performance, compliance is never a firefight, and leadership trusts your forecasts more than their own intuition.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you'll work async in the timezone of your choice - as long as you're around for team calls (early PST).

You'll report directly to Dave Lane (Head of Performance).

You'll work most closely with:

* André Andrade - Creative Lead
* Michael McCann - Head of CRO
* Reinhardt Grobbelaar - Performance Associate

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Google Ads ownership: Over time, you operate the Google accounts day-to-day. UK is the core market and your priority today, with the rest of the EU on the cards this year. Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, Demand Gen. Keyword research, match type strategy, negatives, ad copy, extensions, feed hygiene, landing page alignment, daily optimisation.
* Profit-aware scaling: You push spend up while keeping tCPA / CAC inside target bands. You understand how to grow Search Abs Top IS through budget, bidding, and quality score. You know how to scale a tCPA campaign when actual performance is running well ahead of target without blowing out CACs.
* Compliance mastery & account resilience: You operate cleanly under ASA / CAP and GPhC rules, particularly Rule 12.12 (POMs cannot be advertised to the public). You never reference prescription medicines, named drugs, or use words like "medication" in ad copy. You maintain and evolve our MCC and account structures to keep them resilient against the unique compliance challenges of GLP-1 advertising.
* Multi-geo orchestration: You run multiple country accounts in parallel without dropping balls - different keywords, localised ad copy, different match type strategies, different compliance realities, different reporting cuts. You build the systems that make multi-geo manageable as it grows.
* Ad copy, feed and landing page craft: You write ad copy that converts inside tight character limits and strict compliance rules. You treat Bolt like an e-commerce product on Google Shopping, owning the product feed, data quality, and the ad-to-LP handoff.
* Team building: As we add more buyers alongside you and underneath you, you hire, mentor, and lead the Google pod. You build the bench that this hire is the seed of.

**Need to have**
----------------

* Proven Google scale (hands-on): You've personally operated Google Ads accounts at £1M+/month spend for DTC ecom brands, in the platform yourself every day. Not "led a team that did it." Not "oversaw an agency that did it." ***You*** did it.
* 5+ years of Google-specific depth: You know Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and Demand Gen. You can hold a credible conversation about tCPA vs tROAS vs Max Conversions, match type strategy, quality score levers, negative

jobs.title: Sr. Associate, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
At **Viral Nation,** we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world's fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We're driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we're just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Sr. Associate brings the execution lens to an integrated Performance Marketing pod. Working closely with your Manager, you own campaign build, trafficking, daily optimization, pacing, and QA across performance marketing channels, with an emphasis on paid social, while building fluency in the overarching media plan and strategy so you can speak to both sides of the work.

**What You'll Do Here:**

* Launch, monitor, optimize, and report on media campaigns across paid social channels, with the potential to manage paid search and programmatic campaigns where clients require.
* Own daily optimization, budget pacing, and in-platform troubleshooting to keep campaigns on plan and on target.
* Build and traffic campaigns accurately, owning self-QA before every launch.
* Analyze performance data to refine tactics, and surface in-platform signals, risks, and opportunities to your Manager.
* Support media planning with actuals, reallocations, and audience execution against the strategic media plan.
* Run campaign experimentation across audiences, creative, and bidding to identify what drives performance.
* Evaluate creative and recommend adjustments aligned to platform best practices and client objectives.
* Join internal and external calls, speaking directly to tactical detail and in-platform campaign structure.
* Be a key contributor in performance platform calls, clearly articulating active and upcoming campaign plans and implementing platform provided recommendations where applicable.

**What You Need To Have:**

* 3+ years of media buying experience within paid social. Strong working knowledge of paid search; programmatic experience a strong asset.
* Strong command of the qualitative and quantitative aspects of paid media.
* Proficiency in the Google / Microsoft Suite and project management tools (monday.com, Asana, or ClickUp).
* Strong collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.
* A keen eye for creative content and current marketing trends.
* Working understanding of marketing analytics, QA, and optimization best practices.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled platform features and automation (Advantage+, Performance Max, smart bidding) is a plus.

**Compensation Philosophy:**

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

**AI in Recruitment:**

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

**DEI Commitment:**

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

jobs.description:
Location  
Fully Remote

Schedule  
Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation  
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to  
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type  
Full-time independent contractor

**About RevSpark Media**  
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

**About the Role**  
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

**Your First Focus**  
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

**What You'll Do**  
**Testing Strategy**

* Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
* Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
* Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
* Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

**Account Structure and Quality Standards**

* Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
* Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
* Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
* Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

**Strategic Direction**

* Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
* Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
* Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
* Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

**Performance Analysis**

* Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
* Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
* Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
* Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

**Client Support, As Needed**

* Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
* Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

**Why Work With Us**

* Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
* Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
* Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
* Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
* Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
* Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
* A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
* Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
* Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
* Strong written communication and documentation habits.

**Nice to have**

* Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
* Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
* Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
* Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

Strive Online is a UK Meta-ads agency for trades and home improvement businesses. We run their Facebook and Instagram ads, build their landing pages and send them booked quotes. You’ll run the day-to-day of the agency, so the founder can focus on sales and growth. You’ll own the team, client delivery and the systems that hold it together. This is a hands-on role: you’ll be in the systems, the client data and the team chats, not managing from a distance.

**How the role works**

* **6-month probation:** you work with us on a self-employed basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and National Insurance.
* **After probation:** you move to a permanent, employed contract with PAYE, holiday pay and a workplace pension.

**What you’ll do**

*Team*

* Manage our media buyer, client success manager, Tech VA, sales setter and video contractors.
* Run team meetings, set priorities and hold people to deadlines.
* Help hire, onboard and train new team members as we grow.

*Client delivery*

* Own client onboarding from signed deal to ads live.
* Make sure every client’s ads, landing pages, lead delivery and reporting are on track.
* Oversee complaints and escalations, and step in on difficult clients.
* Track retention and churn, spot at-risk clients early and act before they leave.

*Systems and processes*

* Own our SOPs: keep them up to date, find the gaps and write new ones.
* Improve our software and automations (GoHighLevel, Meta, Tally, Google Drive, Xero) with our developer.
* Build and run a weekly scorecard: leads, cost per lead, bookings, complaints, churn and cash collected.

*Premium offer and filming*

* Plan and run our in-person filming service: book videographers, prepare shot lists, brief clients and get footage into editing.
* Build the delivery process for our premium, higher-ticket clients.

*Commercial*

* Keep an eye on margins, contractor costs and ad account health.
* Report to the founder each week on what’s working, what isn’t and what you’re fixing.

**What we’re looking for**

*Essential*

* At least 2 years in an operations, account management or delivery lead role at a marketing or ads agency.
* Experience managing a small team, including remote or offshore staff.
* Highly organised. You build systems, document everything and nothing falls through the cracks.
* Confident with software, quick to learn new tools, and keen to improve processes.
* Calm, clear and confident with clients, including unhappy ones.
* Good with numbers: you can read a dashboard and tell what’s going wrong.

*Desirable*

* Meta ads knowledge: cost per lead, campaigns, creative testing.
* GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience.
* Use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) in your work.
* Video production or shoot coordination experience.
* Experience with trades or home improvement businesses.

**What you’ll get**

* £40,000 – £50,000 a year (invoiced monthly during probation, then as salary), plus a bonus tied to client retention and delivery targets.
* A permanent employed contract after probation, with holiday pay and a pension.
* Fully remote working.
* A real say in how the agency is run, and a direct line to the founder.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re a global online booking platform operating across multiple country-specific domains, with a custom-built website (not WordPress or a template CMS) and a large, growing footprint of landing pages, country pages, city pages, and long-form blog content spanning dozens of markets.

We’re looking for an SEO specialist who’s comfortable working across both the technical and authority-building sides of SEO, roughly a 30/70 split: **30% basic backend and on-page technical work**, **70% quality backlink creation and content marketing**.

**What you’ll actually work on:**

*Technical & on-page (about 50%)*

* Working with our custom backend to fix on-page issues: meta tags, schema markup, canonical tags, hreflang across multiple country domains
* Coordinating with developers on indexing, crawl efficiency, Core Web Vitals, and page speed issues
* Auditing and cleaning up duplicate or thin content across a large, multi-domain site structure
* Comfortable reading audit tool output (Search Console, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar) and translating it into clear, prioritized fixes

*Backlinks & content marketing (about 50%)*

* Building genuine, relevant backlinks through outreach, guest content, and digital PR, not bulk or low-quality link networks
* Identifying and vetting link opportunities by real traffic and topical relevance, not just a domain authority number
* Repurposing and promoting content across the right channels to support both links and visibility
* Tracking and reporting on link quality, referring domains, and what’s actually moving rankings, not just volume

**What we’re looking for:**

* Real experience with both technical SEO fundamentals and hands-on link building, we need one person who can genuinely do both, not two half-skills
* Comfortable working on a custom-built website without a typical CMS plugin ecosystem to lean on
* Experience with multi-domain or multi-country SEO is a strong plus, understanding hreflang, regional targeting, and avoiding content cannibalization across markets
* Familiarity with Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics
* Someone who can explain their reasoning plainly, we care about understanding why something is being done, not just that it was done

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in travel, booking, or e-commerce SEO specifically
* Familiarity with AI search visibility and structured data for answer engines (schema, FAQ markup, and similar)

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Describe one technical SEO fix you made that had a measurable result, what was broken, what you changed, what happened after?

------------------

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Creative Producer to lead the execution and delivery of marketing creatives.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Brand and Video Production teams to lead creative strategy and production. You'll own the pipeline from creative brainstorming through final delivery for ads to run across brand and performance marketing campaigns. This isn't about making one perfect ad. It's about building a creative machine that feeds our growth with constant testing and iteration.

We want clever ideas, rapid experimentation and consistent excellent ad quality. If you live and breathe performance creative, understand what makes B2B advertising work, and move fast, this role was built for you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own static and video creative production.** Produce creative to run across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Twitter, CTV, OOH, and other networks.

Born from founder Thomas Turner's passion for bringing underground music to Arizona, Relentless Beats is now one of the Southwest's most prolific independent music promoters. Producing over 400 events annually and featuring nearly 500 unique artists, Relentless Beats delivers everything from intimate club shows to marquee festivals like Goldrush Music Festival, PHXLIGHTS, Body Language, DUSK, Decadence AZ, and more.  
  
**Position Overview**  
The Marketing Manager, Clubs plans and executes marketing campaigns for Relentless Beats club events, building audience engagement and driving ticket, table-service, and VIP sales. This role works with artists, venue partners, promoters, and the marketing team across social media, email, digital advertising, and traditional media.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Digital Marketing and Social Media**

* Develop marketing campaigns for club events across social media, email newsletters, and other online channels.
* Create graphics, videos, and written content, working with external photographers, videographers, and designers as needed.
* Contribute to company social media accounts with consistent branding and messaging while engaging online communities and influencers.
* Track reach, engagement, and conversions, using campaign results and current social media trends to improve performance.

  
**Club Promotion and Sales**

* Manage promoters and influencers to increase club-event ticket sales.
* Develop group-sales campaigns and targeted local and regional promotions.

* Develop pop-up events, event series, and other programming at partner venues to attract audiences and fill open calendar dates.

  
**Publicity and Content**

* Work with the publicity team on press releases, media kits, and promotional materials.
* Build media relationships and coordinate artist press opportunities, interviews, scheduling, and follow-up.

**Reporting and Collaboration**

* Collect and analyze sales and campaign data, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and establish realistic sales targets.
* Use historical results to forecast campaign performance.
* Collaborate with other departments to improve ticket, premium, food and beverage, merchandise, and other event revenue.
* Perform other marketing responsibilities as assigned.

  
**Qualifications and Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Music Business, or a related field.
* 4+ years of marketing experience, preferably in music or entertainment, and 2+ years of management experience.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing, audience targeting, social media analytics, email platforms, and content-management systems.
* Proficiency in graphic-design software such as Adobe Creative Suite.
* Strong working knowledge of Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Docs; familiarity with Slack and electronic signature platforms.
* Knowledge of music promotion, industry trends, and emerging technology is a plus.

**Work Environment and Schedule**

Full-time position, salary negotiable. No hiring bonus.

Join a team that powers some of the Southwest's most iconic music events, where accounting accuracy matters, the pace is exciting, and your work directly supports unforgettable live experiences.

new_jobs.title: Receptionist/Administrative Assistant Sales and Marketing
new_jobs.description:
**Fair warning: this is not a “sit at the desk” job.**

At 9am you might be checking in a patient who’s nervous about their first treatment. At 10:30 you’re on the phone with a doctor’s office about an order. By noon you’re picking up dry ice because a shipment goes out today. By 3 you’re posting on Instagram or updating a page on our website. Next month? You could be at a conference, shaking hands with med spa owners who want what we’ve got.

If that sounds chaotic, this isn’t your job.

If that sounds *fun*, keep reading.

**Who we are**

The Stem Cell Club helps people dealing with joint pain, injuries, and life’s wear and tear explore regenerative medicine. ATOM Stem Cells, our sister company, supplies stem cell products to clinics across the country.

Same team. Two companies. Growing fast in Vegas, St. George, and nationwide.

**The hats you’ll wear**

* **Patient Hat.** Answer calls and texts, call back new leads, greet patients, check them in and out, and follow up after treatment so nobody feels forgotten.
* **Computer Hat.** Keep patient records spotless in our CRM, confirm appointments, and track follow-ups. If it’s not in the system, it didn’t happen.
* **Social Media Hat.** Create and post content on our social channels. Patient stories (with permission), behind-the-scenes moments, and stuff from our content calendar.
* **Website Hat.** Update pages, put up new content, and help build out websites as we grow.
* **Doctor Hat.** Visit with physicians and partner clinics, help with ATOM orders, and be the friendly face of the brand.
* **Logistics Hat.** Dry ice runs, shipment prep, and making sure the cells get where they need to go, cold and on time.
* **Road Trip Hat.** Conferences, trade shows, and meetings with med spas and clinics.
* **Whatever’s Next Hat.** We’re growing, and new hats show up every month. You’ll get first dibs.

**Don’t know how to do half of that? Good. Neither did we.**

We’ll train you on all of it: the CRM, social media, websites, the products, the science. You don’t need to show up knowing everything. You need to show up willing to learn it.

**What we can’t train**

A smile. A good attitude. The kind of person who’s genuinely happy to be here.

That’s the whole job, honestly. Our patients are often in pain and nervous, and a warm, happy face at the front desk changes their entire experience. Doctors and clinics feel it too. Skills we can teach. Happy, we hire.

**Let’s be real about the pace**

It gets busy. Phones ring, shipments are due, a patient needs something *right now*. Some days are stressful.

But here’s how we see it: it’s just work. We take care of people seriously, and we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Nobody here is going to lose their mind over a missed call. We figure it out, we laugh about it, and we keep moving.

**You’ll crush it here if you…**

* Smile without being told to (people can hear it on the phone, too)
* Say “I’ve got it” before anyone asks
* Can switch from a patient to a physician to a FedEx counter without missing a beat
* Love learning new things, especially tech
* Want to grow *with* a company, not just collect a paycheck from one
* Have a sense of humor (required, non-negotiable)

**You won’t love it here if you…**

* Think “that’s not my job” is a complete sentence
* Need every day to look the same
* Let a busy day ruin your whole week

**What you get**

* Full training on everything: CRM, social media, websites, products, and more
* A real shot at growing into a bigger role as we expand. The people who start here are the ones who’ll lead later.
* A front-row seat to one of the fastest-moving fields in medicine
* A small team where your work actually gets noticed

**Nice to have (not required):** medical office or front desk experience, bilingual English/Spanish

**How to apply**

Send your resume or call us.

Pay: $15.00 - $22.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

Location: Foxborough, MA studio / Hybrid

**Who we are**

Ink'd makes custom merch, from people who care.

We do custom apparel, company merch stores, and kits for brands like DoorDash and Crocs, plus 1,000+ companies, schools, and nonprofits. Everything gets spec'd, printed, packed, and shipped from our own floor in Massachusetts. We've printed more than a million items, we hit 99.8% of our dates, and every box ships with a handwritten note and a little duck.

We started in 2015 as a 45-day pop-up and stayed for years. No shortcuts. We just kept picking up the phone. We don't do "swag for the sake of swag." We make things people actually want to wear.

**The role**

You'll be the voice of Ink'd online. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and everything else: the content, the calendar, the community and the paid ads. You'll turn a busy print floor and a 10-year founder story into posts that get people to stop scrolling, and you'll turn those posts into leads.

This is not a "schedule three posts a week" job. It's for a hungry self-starter who wants to own a channel, ship fast, learn faster, and see their work show up in the pipeline. Early-career candidates are welcome. We care about drive and talent more than years on a résumé.

**What you'll do**

Own the feeds. Plan and run the content calendar on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok (X and YouTube too). Every channel gets its own voice, and all of it sounds like Ink'd.

Make the content. Shoot and edit short-form video and photos on the floor: presses running, kits getting packed, logos on Lululemon and Patagonia, finished drops landing. Write captions that sound like a person, not a promo catalog.

Run the ads. Build, launch and optimize paid social campaigns (Meta, plus LinkedIn as we grow) aimed at the people who buy merch: HR, people-ops, marketing and office leaders. Test, read the numbers, cut what's not working and scale what is.

Tell the story. Turn Jay's Blog, client wins, new-hire kits and seasonal drops into posts, reels and carousels.

Work LinkedIn. Grow the company page and help amplify the founder's voice where our B2B buyers actually spend their time.

Listen and engage. Reply to comments and DMs, watch what competitors and the promo industry are doing, and spot trends early.

Measure everything. Track reach, engagement, traffic and leads with native analytics and Google Analytics. Report what worked, what didn't, and what you'll try next.

Keep it on-brand. Work with our team on messaging, client features, and protecting our reputation online.

**What you bring**

Real social media experience: a brand, a business, a club, a creator account, or your own feed with results you can show us.

A strong eye for short-form video and the ability to shoot and edit it yourself (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or similar).

Tight, punchy writing. You can say it in five words when everyone else uses twenty.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, or the drive to get great at it fast.

Comfort with numbers. You know what CTR, CPM and CPL mean and you care when they move.

Ownership. You see something that needs doing and you do it without being asked.

Speed and organization. You can juggle a calendar, a shoot and an ad test in the same week.

**Nice to have**

Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) and/or Canva

A scheduling tool such as Hootsuite, Buffer, Later or Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn Ads and B2B social experience

SEO basics and social listening tools

Experience working with influencers or creators

Some familiarity with apparel, merch, printing or e-commerce, or just a love for good gear

**Why join**

You own it. Your ideas go live fast, and you'll see exactly what they do for the business.

There's a lot to film. Presses, embroidery, a million-plus items, and brands like Patagonia, Vuori and YETI coming off our floor.

Real people. A small, close team where everybody picks up the phone and owns the details.

Room to grow. We're growing, and the right person can grow this role into more.

Qualifications & Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is professional, personable, organized, and genuinely excited about the products we sell.

The ideal candidate will have the following qualities:

* **A passion for history:** Enjoys learning about historical events, artifacts, coins, currency, and collectibles.

At Curiosity Coins, you will have the opportunity to work with fascinating items, uncover their stories, learn about the collectibles industry, and help grow a business that connects history with modern online commerce.

This role offers variety, hands-on experience, and the opportunity to develop skills in historical research, inventory management, e-comm

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

**﻿What success looks like**

In your first 90 days:

* You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.

* You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.

* Our competitive win rate is measurably higher, and you can show which of your work moved it.
* Every major release goes to market with a clear story, trained reps, and customer adoption plans.

* The messaging that powers our people and our AI agents is sharp, current, and trusted across the company.

**﻿What you need**

* An AI-native way of working. You've used AI agents, ideally Claude, to automate real GTM workflows, and you can show us what you built.
* A track record of positioning complex platforms for both business and technical buyers, and of winning against an entrenched incumbent.
* Strong sales enablement instincts. You build narratives and assets that get used in the field, and you know how to check that they do.
* Hands-on experience with analyst relations, ideally including a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.
* Excellent writing. You make complicated things simple without making them generic.
* Comfort building without a big team around you: you set your own priorities, move fast, and ship.

**﻿Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in your day-to-day work.
* Experience in event technology, martech, or another platform sold to marketing teams.
* Experience marketing agentic or AI-first products to enterprise buyers.
* Experience with a three-sided value story (in our case, organizers, attendees, and sponsors).
* Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, and comfort pulling your own data from them.
